public-apis/public-apis.summary: 按类别整理的免费公共 API 清单，涵盖天气、地理、金融、开发工具等数十个领域，每条标注是否需要认证、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS。
public-apis/public-apis.summary_en: A categorized list of free public APIs across dozens of domains such as weather, geodata, finance, and developer tools, with each entry noting authentication, HTTPS, and CORS support.

freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp.summary: 非营利组织 freeCodeCamp 的开源代码与课程体系，通过互动练习和项目认证免费教授 Web 开发、数据库、Python 与计算机科学。
freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp.summary_en: The open-source codebase and curriculum of the nonprofit freeCodeCamp, teaching web development, databases, Python, and computer science for free through interactive exercises and certification projects.

donnemartin/system-design-primer.summary: 系统设计入门指南：讲解可扩展系统的常见模式（负载均衡、缓存、分库分表、消息队列等），附面试题、示例方案和 Anki 记忆卡片，提供多语言翻译。
donnemartin/system-design-primer.summary_en: A primer on designing large-scale systems, covering common scalability patterns such as load balancing, caching, sharding, and queues, with interview questions, sample solutions, and Anki flashcards in many languages.

nilbuild/developer-roadmap.summary: roadmap.sh 的内容仓库：为前端、后端、全栈、DevOps、移动开发等方向提供可交互的学习路线图，以及配套的文章、最佳实践和测验。
nilbuild/developer-roadmap.summary_en: The content repository behind roadmap.sh, offering interactive learning roadmaps for front end, back end, full stack, DevOps, and mobile, plus companion articles, best practices, and quizzes.

vinta/awesome-python.summary: 按用途分类的 Python 框架、库和工具精选清单，涵盖 Web 框架、ORM、异步、测试、部署等方向，并提供可搜索的网站。
vinta/awesome-python.summary_en: An opinionated, categorized list of Python frameworks, libraries, and tools, covering web frameworks, ORMs, async, testing, and deployment, with a searchable website.

practical-tutorials/project-based-learni.summary: 按主要编程语言分类的项目式教程合集，带着读者从零构建 Web 应用、游戏、编译器等完整项目，涵盖多种技术栈。
practical-tutorials/project-based-learni.summary_en: A curated list of project-based tutorials, grouped by primary language, that walk through building complete applications such as web apps, games, and compilers from scratch across many stacks.

react/react.summary: Meta 主导的声明式 UI 库，以组件和虚拟 DOM 为核心，同时支持 Web 与原生应用，是当前最主流的前端视图框架之一。
react/react.summary_en: A declarative UI library led by Meta, built around components and a virtual DOM, targeting both web and native apps; it is one of the most widely used front-end view libraries.

vuejs/vue.summary: Vue 2 的代码仓库，渐进式 JavaScript 前端框架，已于 2023 年底结束维护，Vue 3 迁至 vuejs/core。
vuejs/vue.summary_en: The repository of Vue 2, a progressive JavaScript front-end framework, which reached end of life at the end of 2023; Vue 3 lives in vuejs/core.

avelino/awesome-go.summary: Go 语言框架、库和软件的精选清单，按 Web 框架、数据库、认证、微服务等类别整理，是查找 Go 生态组件的入口。
avelino/awesome-go.summary_en: A curated list of Go frameworks, libraries, and software organized by category such as web frameworks, databases, authentication, and microservices, serving as a gateway to the Go ecosystem.

getify/You-Dont-Know-JS.summary: 深入讲解 JavaScript 语言核心机制（作用域、闭包、原型、类型、异步等）的系列书籍，目前为第二版。
getify/You-Dont-Know-JS.summary_en: A book series diving into the core mechanisms of JavaScript, including scope, closures, prototypes, types, and async; currently in its second edition.

flutter/flutter.summary: Google 的跨平台 UI 工具包，使用 Dart 语言，一套代码构建移动、Web 和桌面应用，自带渲染引擎和丰富的 Material / Cupertino 组件。
flutter/flutter.summary_en: Google's cross-platform UI toolkit written in Dart, building mobile, web, and desktop apps from one codebase with its own rendering engine and a rich set of Material and Cupertino widgets.

twbs/bootstrap.summary: 最流行的 HTML / CSS / JS 前端框架之一，提供响应式栅格、预置组件和 Sass 变量，主打移动优先的快速开发。
twbs/bootstrap.summary_en: One of the most popular HTML, CSS, and JavaScript front-end frameworks, offering a responsive grid, prebuilt components, and Sass variables for mobile-first development.

airbnb/javascript.summary: Airbnb 的 JavaScript 代码风格指南，以「合理的做法」为原则逐条给出规则和示例，其 ESLint 配置被广泛采用。
airbnb/javascript.summary_en: Airbnb's JavaScript style guide, presenting rules with rationale and examples in a "mostly reasonable approach"; its ESLint configuration is widely adopted.

vercel/next.js.summary: 基于 React 的全栈框架，支持服务端渲染、静态生成、App Router 与 React Server Components，内置 Rust 编写的构建工具链。
vercel/next.js.summary_en: A React-based full-stack framework supporting server-side rendering, static generation, the App Router, and React Server Components, with a Rust-based build toolchain.

golang/go.summary: Go 编程语言的官方仓库，包含编译器、标准库和工具链，主打简洁、并发和高效的编译，广泛用于后端服务与云原生基础设施。
golang/go.summary_en: The official repository of the Go programming language, containing the compiler, standard library, and toolchain; known for simplicity, concurrency, and fast builds, and widely used for backend services and cloud infrastructure.

ripienaar/free-for-dev.summary: 面向开发和运维的 SaaS、PaaS、IaaS 免费额度清单，涵盖托管、数据库、CI/CD、监控、邮件等，方便个人项目和初创团队选型。
ripienaar/free-for-dev.summary_en: A list of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with free tiers for developers and ops, covering hosting, databases, CI/CD, monitoring, and email, useful for side projects and early-stage teams.

Chalarangelo/30-seconds-of-code.summary: 面向 JavaScript、Python、CSS、React、Git 等的短小实用代码片段与文章合集，可按标签和语言检索。
Chalarangelo/30-seconds-of-code.summary_en: A collection of short, practical code snippets and articles for JavaScript, Python, CSS, React, Git, and more, searchable by tag and language.

kubernetes/kubernetes.summary: 容器编排系统，负责跨主机的容器化应用部署、扩缩容和运维，是云原生基础设施的事实标准。
kubernetes/kubernetes.summary_en: The container orchestration system that automates deployment, scaling, and operation of containerized applications across hosts, and the de facto standard for cloud-native infrastructure.

react/react-native.summary: 用 React 构建原生 Android / iOS 应用的框架，JavaScript 编写业务逻辑并渲染为真正的原生组件。
react/react-native.summary_en: A framework for building native Android and iOS apps with React, where JavaScript drives the logic and renders real native components.

shadcn-ui/ui.summary: 一套可访问、可定制的 React 组件，以「复制代码到自己项目」的方式分发而非 npm 依赖，基于 Radix UI 与 Tailwind CSS，提供 CLI 安装。
shadcn-ui/ui.summary_en: A set of accessible, customizable React components distributed as code you copy into your project rather than as an npm dependency, built on Radix UI and Tailwind CSS with a CLI installer.

electron/electron.summary: 用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用的框架，内嵌 Chromium 与 Node.js，VS Code 等众多桌面应用基于它开发。
electron/electron.summary_en: A framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, bundling Chromium and Node.js; apps such as VS Code are built on it.

nodejs/node.summary: 基于 V8 引擎的开源 JavaScript 运行时，采用事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，由 OpenJS 基金会治理，是服务端 JavaScript 的基础。
nodejs/node.summary_en: An open-source JavaScript runtime built on the V8 engine with an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model, governed by the OpenJS Foundation and the foundation of server-side JavaScript.

rust-lang/rust.summary: Rust 语言的官方仓库，包含编译器、标准库和文档，以所有权系统在无垃圾回收的前提下保证内存安全，常用于高性能服务和 WebAssembly。
rust-lang/rust.summary_en: The official repository of the Rust language with its compiler, standard library, and docs; its ownership system guarantees memory safety without garbage collection, and it is common in high-performance services and WebAssembly.

mrdoob/three.js.summary: 在浏览器中渲染 3D 图形的 JavaScript 库，封装 WebGL / WebGPU，提供场景、相机、材质、动画等抽象。
mrdoob/three.js.summary_en: A JavaScript library for rendering 3D graphics in the browser, wrapping WebGL and WebGPU with abstractions for scenes, cameras, materials, and animation.

d3/d3.summary: 用 SVG、Canvas 和 HTML 驱动数据可视化的 JavaScript 库，以数据绑定和丰富的比例尺、布局模块著称，是众多图表库的底层。
d3/d3.summary_en: A JavaScript library for data-driven visualization with SVG, Canvas, and HTML, known for data binding and rich scale and layout modules; many charting libraries build on it.

tauri-apps/tauri.summary: 用 Web 前端加 Rust 后端构建体积小、安全的桌面与移动应用的框架，使用系统 WebView 而非内嵌浏览器，可搭配任意前端框架。
tauri-apps/tauri.summary_en: A framework for building small, secure desktop and mobile apps with a web front end and a Rust back end, using the system WebView instead of a bundled browser and working with any front-end framework.

microsoft/TypeScript.summary: JavaScript 的超集，增加可选静态类型并编译为标准 JavaScript，提供类型检查与语言服务，是大型前后端项目的主流选择。
microsoft/TypeScript.summary_en: A superset of JavaScript that adds optional static types and compiles to plain JavaScript, with type checking and language services; a mainstream choice for large front-end and back-end projects.

supabase/supabase.summary: 以 Postgres 为核心的开源后端即服务，提供托管数据库、认证、自动生成的 REST / GraphQL API、实时订阅、存储和边缘函数，定位为开源版 Firebase。
supabase/supabase.summary_en: An open-source backend-as-a-service centered on Postgres, offering a hosted database, auth, auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, realtime subscriptions, storage, and edge functions as an open alternative to Firebase.

fatedier/frp.summary: 内网穿透用的高性能反向代理，可把 NAT 或防火墙后的本地服务（TCP、UDP、HTTP、HTTPS）暴露到公网，常用于本地调试和远程访问。
fatedier/frp.summary_en: A high-performance reverse proxy that exposes local services behind NAT or firewalls (TCP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS) to the internet, commonly used for local debugging and remote access.

axios/axios.summary: 基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端，同时支持浏览器和 Node.js，提供拦截器、请求取消、自动 JSON 转换等功能。
axios/axios.summary_en: A Promise-based HTTP client for both browsers and Node.js, with interceptors, request cancellation, and automatic JSON transformation.

denoland/deno.summary: 由 Node.js 作者创建的 JavaScript / TypeScript / WebAssembly 运行时，默认安全（显式授权权限）、原生支持 TypeScript，并内置格式化、测试等工具。
denoland/deno.summary_en: A JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly runtime from the creator of Node.js, secure by default with explicit permissions, native TypeScript support, and built-in formatter and test tools.

goldbergyoni/nodebestpractices.summary: Node.js 最佳实践清单，涵盖项目结构、错误处理、代码风格、测试、生产环境、安全和性能等方面，逐条给出反例和正例。
goldbergyoni/nodebestpractices.summary_en: A list of Node.js best practices covering project structure, error handling, code style, testing, production, security, and performance, with bad and good examples for each item.

react/create-react-app.summary: 一条命令创建 React 单页应用的脚手架，基于 webpack，曾是官方推荐的起步方式，现已弃用，官方建议改用 React 框架。
react/create-react-app.summary_en: A scaffold that sets up a React single-page app with one command on top of webpack; once the officially recommended starting point, it is now deprecated in favor of React frameworks.

fastapi/fastapi.summary: 现代高性能 Python Web 框架，基于类型注解自动做请求校验和序列化，并生成 OpenAPI 与交互式文档，支持异步。
fastapi/fastapi.summary_en: A modern high-performance Python web framework that uses type hints for request validation and serialization, generates OpenAPI schemas and interactive docs, and supports async.

angular/angular.summary: Google 主导的 TypeScript 前端平台，提供组件、依赖注入、路由、表单、HTTP 等完整能力，面向大型应用。
angular/angular.summary_en: A TypeScript front-end platform led by Google, offering components, dependency injection, routing, forms, and HTTP out of the box for large applications.

ant-design/ant-design.summary: 蚂蚁集团的企业级 React UI 组件库与设计语言，提供数据密集型后台常用的表格、表单、布局等丰富组件，中文生态成熟。
ant-design/ant-design.summary_en: Ant Group's enterprise-class React UI library and design language, with rich components for data-heavy admin interfaces such as tables, forms, and layouts, and a mature Chinese-language ecosystem.

mui/material-ui.summary: 实现 Google Material Design 的 React 组件库，提供样式系统与主题定制，另有数据表格、图表等进阶组件。
mui/material-ui.summary_en: A React component library implementing Google's Material Design, with a styling system and theming plus advanced components such as data grids and charts.

tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.summary: 原子化（utility-first）CSS 框架，直接在标记里组合类名构建界面，通过构建时扫描按需生成样式，体积小且易定制。
tailwindlabs/tailwindcss.summary_en: A utility-first CSS framework where interfaces are composed from class names directly in markup, generating only the styles you use at build time for small, customizable output.

microsoft/Web-Dev-For-Beginners.summary: 微软出品的 12 周 24 课 Web 开发入门课程，用 JavaScript、CSS、HTML 完成实战小项目，附测验和作业。
microsoft/Web-Dev-For-Beginners.summary_en: Microsoft's 12-week, 24-lesson beginner web development curriculum, teaching JavaScript, CSS, and HTML through hands-on projects, with quizzes and assignments.

microsoft/playwright.summary: 微软的端到端测试与浏览器自动化框架，用同一套 API 驱动 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit，支持自动等待、追踪回放和多语言绑定。
microsoft/playwright.summary_en: Microsoft's end-to-end testing and browser automation framework, driving Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with one API, with auto-waiting, trace replay, and multi-language bindings.

oven-sh/bun.summary: 一体化 JavaScript / TypeScript 工具包：运行时、打包器、测试运行器和包管理器合一，基于 JavaScriptCore，主打启动与安装速度。
oven-sh/bun.summary_en: An all-in-one JavaScript and TypeScript toolkit combining a runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager, built on JavaScriptCore with a focus on startup and install speed.

puppeteer/puppeteer.summary: 通过 DevTools 协议或 WebDriver BiDi 控制 Chrome / Firefox 的 Node.js 库，默认无头运行，常用于自动化测试、截图和爬取。
puppeteer/puppeteer.summary_en: A Node.js library that controls Chrome or Firefox over the DevTools Protocol or WebDriver BiDi, headless by default, commonly used for automated testing, screenshots, and scraping.

nvm-sh/nvm.summary: POSIX 兼容的 Node 版本管理脚本，可在同一台机器上安装并切换多个 Node.js 版本，按项目的 .nvmrc 自动选择。
nvm-sh/nvm.summary_en: A POSIX-compliant shell script for managing Node.js versions, allowing several versions to be installed and switched on one machine, including per-project selection via .nvmrc.

ryanmcdermott/clean-code-javascript.summary: 把《代码整洁之道》的原则改写为 JavaScript 实践，涵盖变量、函数、对象、类、SOLID、测试和错误处理等主题。
ryanmcdermott/clean-code-javascript.summary_en: Clean Code principles adapted to JavaScript, covering variables, functions, objects, classes, SOLID, testing, and error handling.

louislam/uptime-kuma.summary: 自托管的服务可用性监控工具，支持 HTTP、TCP、Ping、DNS 等多种检测，带状态页与多渠道告警通知。
louislam/uptime-kuma.summary_en: A self-hosted uptime monitoring tool supporting HTTP, TCP, ping, and DNS checks, with public status pages and alerting through many notification channels.

django/django.summary: Python 的全功能 Web 框架，内置 ORM、管理后台、认证、模板和迁移，遵循「电池全包」的设计理念。
django/django.summary_en: A batteries-included Python web framework with a built-in ORM, admin site, authentication, templating, and migrations.

storybookjs/storybook.summary: UI 组件的隔离开发环境，可以在独立于应用的沙盒里构建、预览、文档化和测试组件，支持 React、Vue、Angular 等多种框架。
storybookjs/storybook.summary_en: A workshop for building, previewing, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation from the app, supporting React, Vue, Angular, and other frameworks.

astral-sh/uv.summary: 用 Rust 写的极速 Python 包与项目管理器，可替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv、virtualenv 等，比 pip 快 10 到 100 倍。
astral-sh/uv.summary_en: An extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust, replacing pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, virtualenv, and more, and 10 to 100 times faster than pip.

PanJiaChen/vue-element-admin.summary: 基于 Vue 与 Element UI 的后台管理前端方案，内置权限验证、动态路由、多环境构建和典型业务模板，是国内流行的 Vue 后台脚手架。
PanJiaChen/vue-element-admin.summary_en: A front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue and Element UI, with permission checks, dynamic routing, multi-environment builds, and typical business templates; a popular Vue admin scaffold in China.

ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101.summary: 用图示和简明语言讲解复杂系统的合集，覆盖 API 设计、缓存、数据库、微服务、DevOps 等主题，兼顾系统设计面试准备。
ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101.summary_en: A collection that explains complex systems with diagrams and plain language, covering API design, caching, databases, microservices, and DevOps, useful for system design interview preparation.

gohugoio/hugo.summary: Go 编写的静态站点生成器，以构建速度极快著称，支持主题、短代码、多语言和 Markdown 内容，常用于博客与文档站。
gohugoio/hugo.summary_en: A static site generator written in Go, known for very fast builds, with themes, shortcodes, multilingual support, and Markdown content; commonly used for blogs and documentation sites.

gin-gonic/gin.summary: Go 语言高性能 HTTP Web 框架，基于 httprouter，提供中间件、路由分组、参数绑定和 JSON 校验，是 Go 后端最常用的框架之一。
gin-gonic/gin.summary_en: A high-performance HTTP web framework for Go based on httprouter, with middleware, route groups, parameter binding, and JSON validation; among the most used Go back-end frameworks.

sveltejs/svelte.summary: 以编译器方式工作的前端框架，在构建阶段把声明式组件转成直接更新 DOM 的 JavaScript，没有虚拟 DOM，运行时体积小。
sveltejs/svelte.summary_en: A front-end framework that works as a compiler, turning declarative components into JavaScript that updates the DOM directly at build time, with no virtual DOM and a small runtime.

laravel/laravel.summary: Laravel 应用骨架仓库：PHP 全栈 Web 框架，提供路由、Eloquent ORM、队列、认证和 Blade 模板，以优雅的语法和完整生态著称。
laravel/laravel.summary_en: The application skeleton of Laravel, a full-stack PHP web framework with routing, the Eloquent ORM, queues, authentication, and Blade templating, known for elegant syntax and a complete ecosystem.

macrozheng/mall.summary: 基于 Spring Boot 和 MyBatis 的电商系统示例，包含前台商城与后台管理，配套完整教程，并以 Docker 容器化部署，是国内常见的 Java 全栈学习项目。
macrozheng/mall.summary_en: An e-commerce reference system built with Spring Boot and MyBatis, with a storefront and an admin backend, complete tutorials, and Docker-based deployment; a common Java full-stack learning project in China.

bregman-arie/devops-exercises.summary: 覆盖 Linux、Kubernetes、Docker、Terraform、AWS 等主题的 DevOps / SRE 练习题与面试题库，累计两千多道题。
bregman-arie/devops-exercises.summary_en: A bank of DevOps and SRE exercises and interview questions covering Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, and more, with over two thousand entries.

realworld-apps/realworld.summary: 「RealWorld」全栈示例：同一个 Medium 克隆应用，用不同前端（React、Angular 等）和后端（Node、Django 等）实现，共享统一 API 规范，可任意组合。
realworld-apps/realworld.summary_en: The RealWorld full-stack example: one Medium clone implemented with many front ends (React, Angular, and others) and back ends (Node, Django, and others) that share a single API spec and can be mixed and matched.

vitejs/vite.summary: 新一代前端构建工具，开发时利用浏览器原生 ES 模块实现秒级启动与热更新，生产构建基于 Rollup，插件生态丰富。
vitejs/vite.summary_en: A next-generation front-end build tool that starts instantly and hot-reloads in development using native ES modules, builds for production with Rollup, and has a rich plugin ecosystem.

animate-css/animate.css.summary: 纯 CSS 动画库，提供淡入、弹跳、滑动等即用型动画类，加上类名即可使用。
animate-css/animate.css.summary_en: A pure-CSS animation library of ready-to-use effects such as fades, bounces, and slides, applied by adding a class name.

spring-projects/spring-boot.summary: Java 生态最主流的应用框架，以自动配置、起步依赖和内嵌服务器让 Spring 应用「开箱即用」，适合构建生产级服务与微服务。
spring-projects/spring-boot.summary_en: The dominant application framework in the Java ecosystem, using auto-configuration, starter dependencies, and embedded servers to make Spring apps run out of the box for production services and microservices.

netdata/netdata.summary: 实时基础设施监控工具，一行命令安装即可按秒采集主机、容器和应用的指标，自带仪表盘、异常检测与告警。
netdata/netdata.summary_en: A real-time infrastructure monitoring tool that installs with one command and collects per-second metrics for hosts, containers, and apps, with dashboards, anomaly detection, and alerts.

hoppscotch/hoppscotch.summary: 开源 API 开发工具，可调试 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket 等接口，提供 Web、桌面和命令行版本，定位为 Postman 和 Insomnia 的开源替代。
hoppscotch/hoppscotch.summary_en: An open-source API development tool for testing REST, GraphQL, and WebSocket endpoints, available on web, desktop, and CLI, positioned as an open alternative to Postman and Insomnia.

doocs/advanced-java.summary: 面向 Java 后端工程师的进阶知识与面试题梳理，涵盖高并发、分布式、高可用、微服务和海量数据处理。
doocs/advanced-java.summary_en: Advanced knowledge and interview questions for Java back-end engineers, covering high concurrency, distributed systems, high availability, microservices, and large-scale data processing.

elastic/elasticsearch.summary: 分布式搜索与分析引擎，基于 Lucene，提供 RESTful 接口、全文检索、聚合分析和向量检索，是 Elastic Stack 的核心。
elastic/elasticsearch.summary_en: A distributed search and analytics engine built on Lucene, offering a RESTful API, full-text search, aggregations, and vector search, and the core of the Elastic Stack.

python/cpython.summary: Python 语言的官方参考实现，包含解释器、标准库和文档，广泛用于 Web 后端、脚本自动化和数据处理。
python/cpython.summary_en: The reference implementation of Python, containing the interpreter, standard library, and docs, widely used for web back ends, scripting automation, and data processing.

grafana/grafana.summary: 开源可观测性与数据可视化平台，可查询 Prometheus、Loki、Elasticsearch、Postgres 等多种数据源，构建仪表盘并设置告警。
grafana/grafana.summary_en: An open-source observability and data-visualization platform that queries sources such as Prometheus, Loki, Elasticsearch, and Postgres to build dashboards and alerts.

FortAwesome/Font-Awesome.summary: 使用最广的图标库，以 SVG、字体和 CSS 形式提供数千个图标，免费版与 Pro 版并行。
FortAwesome/Font-Awesome.summary_en: The most widely used icon library, delivering thousands of icons as SVG, web fonts, and CSS, with both free and Pro tiers.

nestjs/nest.summary: 基于 TypeScript 的渐进式 Node.js 服务端框架，借鉴 Angular 的模块、依赖注入与装饰器设计，底层可接 Express 或 Fastify，适合构建企业级后端。
nestjs/nest.summary_en: A progressive TypeScript-first Node.js server framework that borrows Angular's modules, dependency injection, and decorators, running on Express or Fastify, suited to enterprise back ends.

redis/redis.summary: 内存数据结构服务器，可作缓存、数据库和消息代理，支持字符串、哈希、列表、集合、流等数据类型，并提供文档与向量查询能力。
redis/redis.summary_en: An in-memory data-structure server used as a cache, database, and message broker, supporting strings, hashes, lists, sets, streams, and more, with document and vector query capabilities.

caddyserver/caddy.summary: 默认启用 HTTPS 的可扩展 Web 服务器，自动申请和续期证书，支持 HTTP/1/2/3，用简洁的 Caddyfile 配置反向代理和静态站点。
caddyserver/caddy.summary_en: An extensible web server with HTTPS on by default, automatically obtaining and renewing certificates, supporting HTTP/1, 2, and 3, and configuring reverse proxies and static sites through a concise Caddyfile.

typicode/json-server.summary: 用一个 JSON 文件在 30 秒内搭出完整的假 REST API，方便前端在后端就绪前联调和做原型。
typicode/json-server.summary_en: Spins up a full fake REST API from a single JSON file in seconds, letting front-end developers prototype and integrate before the back end exists.

pallets/flask.summary: 轻量级 Python WSGI Web 微框架，基于 Werkzeug 和 Jinja，核心精简、通过扩展按需增加功能，易上手也能扩展到复杂应用。
pallets/flask.summary_en: A lightweight Python WSGI micro web framework built on Werkzeug and Jinja, with a small core extended through plugins, easy to start with yet scalable to complex apps.

enaqx/awesome-react.summary: React 生态精选清单，涵盖框架、组件库、状态管理与数据请求、样式、图标、工具和学习资源。
enaqx/awesome-react.summary_en: A curated list of the React ecosystem, covering frameworks, component libraries, state management and data fetching, styling, icons, tools, and learning resources.

binhnguyennus/awesome-scalability.summary: 可扩展、高可靠、高性能大型系统的阅读清单，收集知名工程师的文章和各公司的架构案例，按扩展性、可用性、性能等主题分类。
binhnguyennus/awesome-scalability.summary_en: A reading list on scalable, reliable, and performant large-scale systems, collecting articles from prominent engineers and architecture case studies organized by scalability, availability, and performance.

vuejs/awesome-vue.summary: Vue.js 精选清单，收录官方资源、组件库、插件、工具、教程和示例项目。
vuejs/awesome-vue.summary_en: A curated list for Vue.js covering official resources, component libraries, plugins, tools, tutorials, and example projects.

strapi/strapi.summary: 开源无头 CMS，用 JavaScript / TypeScript 编写，提供可视化内容类型建模、自动生成的 REST 与 GraphQL API、管理面板和权限系统，可自托管。
strapi/strapi.summary_en: An open-source headless CMS written in JavaScript and TypeScript, with visual content-type modeling, auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, an admin panel, and a permission system; self-hostable.

juliangarnier/anime.summary: 轻量的 JavaScript 动画引擎（Anime.js），可对 CSS 属性、SVG、DOM 属性和 JS 对象做补间动画，API 简洁。
juliangarnier/anime.summary_en: Anime.js, a lightweight JavaScript animation engine that tweens CSS properties, SVG, DOM attributes, and JavaScript objects through a simple API.

nektos/act.summary: 在本地运行 GitHub Actions 工作流，用 Docker 模拟 runner，无需每次提交推送就能调试 CI 配置。
nektos/act.summary_en: Runs GitHub Actions workflows locally using Docker to emulate runners, so you can debug CI configuration without committing and pushing each time.

moby/moby.summary: Docker 发起的容器化开源项目，提供可组装的容器组件工具集，是 Docker Engine 的上游。
moby/moby.summary_en: The open-source containerization project started by Docker, providing a set of assemblable container components; it is the upstream of Docker Engine.

protocolbuffers/protobuf.summary: Google 的语言无关、平台无关结构化数据序列化格式（Protocol Buffers），通过 .proto 定义生成多语言代码，常与 gRPC 搭配。
protocolbuffers/protobuf.summary_en: Google's language- and platform-neutral serialization format for structured data, generating code in many languages from .proto definitions and commonly paired with gRPC.

swiftlang/swift.summary: Swift 语言仓库，包含编译器和标准库，语法简洁、默认内存安全，用于 iOS / macOS 应用，也可写服务端。
swiftlang/swift.summary_en: The repository of the Swift language with its compiler and standard library, featuring clean syntax and memory safety by default; used for iOS and macOS apps and also for server-side code.

expressjs/express.summary: Node.js 上快速、极简、不预设结构的 Web 框架，提供路由和中间件机制，是最广泛使用的 Node 后端框架。
expressjs/express.summary_en: A fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for Node.js with routing and middleware, and the most widely used Node back-end framework.

chartjs/Chart.js.summary: 基于 HTML5 Canvas 的简单灵活的 JavaScript 图表库，内置折线、柱状、饼图等常见图表，支持响应式与动画。
chartjs/Chart.js.summary_en: A simple, flexible JavaScript charting library on HTML5 Canvas, with built-in line, bar, and pie charts, responsive layout, and animation.

apache/echarts.summary: Apache 基金会的交互式图表与数据可视化库，功能丰富、图表类型多，支持大数据量渲染与主题定制，在国内使用广泛。
apache/echarts.summary_en: An interactive charting and data-visualization library from the Apache Foundation with many chart types, large-data rendering, and theming; widely used in China.

bradtraversy/design-resources-for-develo.summary: 面向开发者的设计与 UI 资源清单，包含图片素材、字体、配色、图标、Web 模板、CSS 框架和 UI 库等。
bradtraversy/design-resources-for-develo.summary_en: A curated list of design and UI resources for developers, including stock photos, fonts, colors, icons, web templates, CSS frameworks, and UI libraries.

sindresorhus/awesome-nodejs.summary: Node.js 包与资源精选清单，按用途分类，涵盖框架、数据库、CLI、测试、文档等。
sindresorhus/awesome-nodejs.summary_en: A curated list of Node.js packages and resources grouped by purpose, covering frameworks, databases, CLI, testing, and documentation.

leonardomso/33-js-concepts.summary: 每个 JavaScript 开发者都应掌握的 33 个核心概念，配文章与学习资料链接，涵盖闭包、原型、事件循环、异步等。
leonardomso/33-js-concepts.summary_en: 33 core concepts every JavaScript developer should know, with articles and learning links covering closures, prototypes, the event loop, and async.

facebook/docusaurus.summary: Meta 开源的文档站点生成器，基于 React，支持 Markdown / MDX、版本管理、多语言和搜索，很多开源项目文档站使用它。
facebook/docusaurus.summary_en: Meta's open-source documentation site generator built on React, with Markdown and MDX, versioning, i18n, and search; used for the docs of many open-source projects.

prometheus/prometheus.summary: 云原生监控系统与时序数据库，按配置的目标拉取指标，提供 PromQL 查询语言与告警规则，是 CNCF 毕业项目。
prometheus/prometheus.summary_en: A cloud-native monitoring system and time-series database that scrapes metrics from configured targets, with the PromQL query language and alerting rules; a CNCF graduated project.

webpack/webpack.summary: JavaScript 模块打包器，通过 loader 处理各类资源，支持代码分割、按需加载和丰富的插件体系，是长期主流的前端构建工具。
webpack/webpack.summary_en: A JavaScript module bundler that processes many asset types through loaders, with code splitting, on-demand loading, and a rich plugin system; long the mainstream front-end build tool.

lydiahallie/javascript-questions.summary: 一组进阶 JavaScript 选择题及详细解析，考察作用域、原型、异步、类型转换等易错点。
lydiahallie/javascript-questions.summary_en: A set of advanced JavaScript multiple-choice questions with detailed explanations that probe tricky areas such as scope, prototypes, async, and type coercion.

localstack/localstack.summary: 在本地模拟完整 AWS 云环境的工具，可离线开发和测试云与 Serverless 应用，减少对真实 AWS 账号的依赖；仓库已归档。
localstack/localstack.summary_en: A tool that emulates the AWS cloud locally so cloud and serverless apps can be developed and tested offline without depending on real AWS accounts; the repository is archived.

nocodb/nocodb.summary: 可自托管的 Airtable 开源替代品，把 MySQL、Postgres、SQLite 等数据库变成带表格视图的界面，并自动生成 API。
nocodb/nocodb.summary_en: A self-hostable open-source Airtable alternative that turns databases such as MySQL, Postgres, and SQLite into a spreadsheet-style interface and auto-generates APIs.

traefik/traefik.summary: 云原生 HTTP 反向代理与负载均衡器，能自动发现 Docker、Kubernetes 等后端并动态更新路由，内置 Let's Encrypt 支持。
traefik/traefik.summary_en: A cloud-native HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that automatically discovers backends such as Docker and Kubernetes and updates routes dynamically, with built-in Let's Encrypt support.

socketio/socket.io.summary: 基于 WebSocket 的双向低延迟实时通信库，含服务端与客户端，自带断线重连、房间与广播、长轮询降级。
socketio/socket.io.summary_en: A bidirectional, low-latency real-time communication library on WebSocket with server and client, featuring automatic reconnection, rooms and broadcast, and long-polling fallback.

withastro/astro.summary: 面向内容型网站的 Web 框架，采用「群岛架构」默认输出零 JavaScript，可在同一项目里混用 React、Vue、Svelte 等组件。
withastro/astro.summary_en: A web framework for content-driven sites using an islands architecture that ships zero JavaScript by default, letting you mix React, Vue, Svelte, and other components in one project.

coollabsio/coolify.summary: 可自托管的开源 PaaS，替代 Vercel、Heroku、Netlify，用于在自己的服务器上部署静态站、数据库、全栈应用和 280 多个一键服务。
coollabsio/coolify.summary_en: A self-hostable open-source PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku, and Netlify for deploying static sites, databases, full-stack apps, and 280+ one-click services on your own servers.

reduxjs/redux.summary: JavaScript 应用的可预测全局状态容器，通过单向数据流、纯函数 reducer 和中间件管理状态，常与 React 配合。
reduxjs/redux.summary_en: A predictable global state container for JavaScript apps that manages state through unidirectional data flow, pure reducers, and middleware, commonly used with React.

Solido/awesome-flutter.summary: Flutter 库、工具、教程和文章的精选清单，按状态管理、网络、UI、动画等分类。
Solido/awesome-flutter.summary_en: A curated list of Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles organized by state management, networking, UI, animation, and more.

minio/minio.summary: 高性能、兼容 S3 的对象存储，可自托管；仓库已声明不再维护，官方推荐改用其商业产品 AIStor。
minio/minio.summary_en: A high-performance, S3-compatible object store you can self-host; the repository is marked as no longer maintained, with the vendor pointing to its AIStor products instead.

lodash/lodash.summary: JavaScript 工具函数库，提供数组、对象、字符串、集合等的常用操作，模块化设计，是使用最广的 npm 包之一。
lodash/lodash.summary_en: A JavaScript utility library with everyday helpers for arrays, objects, strings, and collections, modular in design and one of the most widely used npm packages.

pocketbase/pocketbase.summary: 用 Go 写的单文件开源后端：内嵌 SQLite、实时订阅、用户与文件管理、管理后台和 REST 风格 API，适合小型应用和原型。
pocketbase/pocketbase.summary_en: An open-source back end in a single Go binary with embedded SQLite, realtime subscriptions, user and file management, an admin UI, and a REST-style API; well suited to small apps and prototypes.

nuxt/nuxt.summary: 基于 Vue 的全栈框架，提供文件路由、服务端渲染、自动导入、模块生态和 Nitro 服务引擎，类型安全。
nuxt/nuxt.summary_en: A Vue-based full-stack framework with file-based routing, server-side rendering, auto-imports, a module ecosystem, and the Nitro server engine, with type safety.

h5bp/Front-end-Developer-Interview-Quest.summary: 前端面试题清单，按 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 等主题分类，既可用于面试候选人也可用来自测。
h5bp/Front-end-Developer-Interview-Quest.summary_en: A list of front-end interview questions organized by HTML, CSS, and JavaScript topics, usable for vetting candidates or self-testing.

xingshaocheng/architect-awesome.summary: 面向后端架构师的技术图谱，梳理数据结构、网络、数据库、缓存、消息队列、微服务、高并发等知识点与参考资料。
xingshaocheng/architect-awesome.summary_en: A technology map for back-end architects, laying out data structures, networking, databases, caching, message queues, microservices, and high concurrency with reference material.

spring-projects/spring-framework.summary: Spring 全家桶的基础框架，提供依赖注入、面向切面编程、Web MVC / WebFlux、数据访问与事务管理等核心能力。
spring-projects/spring-framework.summary_en: The foundation of the Spring family, providing dependency injection, aspect-oriented programming, Web MVC and WebFlux, data access, and transaction management.

jquery/jquery.summary: 经典 JavaScript 库，简化 DOM 操作、事件处理、Ajax 和动画，抹平早期浏览器差异，仍存在于大量存量网站中。
jquery/jquery.summary_en: The classic JavaScript library that simplifies DOM manipulation, event handling, Ajax, and animation and smoothed over early browser differences; still present on a huge number of sites.

FiloSottile/mkcert.summary: 零配置生成本地受信任开发证书的工具，自动创建本地 CA 并装入系统信任库，方便在本地用 HTTPS 调试。
FiloSottile/mkcert.summary_en: A zero-config tool for making locally trusted development certificates, creating a local CA and installing it in the system trust store so HTTPS can be used in local development.

meilisearch/meilisearch.summary: 用 Rust 写的高速搜索引擎，开箱即用地支持容错拼写、过滤、分面和混合（关键词加向量）检索，适合给网站和应用加搜索。
meilisearch/meilisearch.summary_en: A fast search engine written in Rust that offers typo tolerance, filtering, facets, and hybrid keyword-plus-vector search out of the box, suited to adding search to sites and apps.

rails/rails.summary: Ruby 全栈 Web 框架，遵循 MVC 与「约定优于配置」，内置 Active Record、路由、邮件、任务队列和前端集成。
rails/rails.summary_en: A full-stack Ruby web framework following MVC and convention over configuration, with Active Record, routing, mailers, job queues, and front-end integration built in.

pmndrs/zustand.summary: 小巧、快速的 React 状态管理库，基于 hooks，API 极简、无需 Provider 和样板代码。
pmndrs/zustand.summary_en: A small, fast React state-management library based on hooks, with a minimal API and no providers or boilerplate.

angular/angular.js.summary: AngularJS（Angular 1.x），早期的 MVC 前端框架，用指令扩展 HTML 并提供双向数据绑定，已停止维护。
angular/angular.js.summary_en: AngularJS (Angular 1.x), an early MVC front-end framework that extends HTML with directives and two-way data binding; no longer maintained.

wasabeef/awesome-android-ui.summary: Android UI / UX 库精选清单，按 Jetpack Compose、布局、列表、表单、图片、菜单等分类。
wasabeef/awesome-android-ui.summary_en: A curated list of Android UI and UX libraries grouped by Jetpack Compose, layouts, lists, forms, images, menus, and more.

h5bp/html5-boilerplate.summary: 前端模板项目，汇集十多年社区经验的合理默认值（重置样式、缓存与安全配置等），作为构建快速健壮网站的起点。
h5bp/html5-boilerplate.summary_en: A front-end template collecting more than a decade of community-tested defaults such as style resets, caching, and security settings as a starting point for fast, robust sites.

appwrite/appwrite.summary: 开源后端即服务，提供认证、数据库、存储、云函数、消息、实时和托管，可自托管，覆盖 Web、移动与服务端 SDK。
appwrite/appwrite.summary_en: An open-source backend-as-a-service offering auth, databases, storage, functions, messaging, realtime, and hosting, self-hostable, with SDKs for web, mobile, and server.

golang-standards/project-layout.summary: Go 项目的常见目录结构约定（cmd、internal、pkg 等），社区总结的布局参考，并非官方标准。
golang-standards/project-layout.summary_en: A common directory layout convention for Go projects (cmd, internal, pkg, and so on), a community reference rather than an official standard.

remix-run/react-router.summary: React 的声明式路由库，支持嵌套路由、数据加载与提交，并可作为框架模式使用，已与 Remix 合并发展。
remix-run/react-router.summary_en: The declarative routing library for React, with nested routes, data loading and actions, and a framework mode; it has merged with Remix.

gatsbyjs/gatsby.summary: 基于 React 和 GraphQL 的静态站点框架，构建时聚合各类数据源生成高性能站点，曾是 JAMstack 代表。
gatsbyjs/gatsby.summary_en: A React and GraphQL static-site framework that pulls in many data sources at build time to generate fast sites; once a flagship of the JAMstack.

TryGhost/Ghost.summary: 开源出版与会员订阅平台，用 Node.js 编写，提供写作编辑器、邮件通讯、付费会员和无头 API，可自托管。
TryGhost/Ghost.summary_en: An open-source publishing and membership platform written in Node.js, with an editor, newsletters, paid memberships, and a headless API; self-hostable.

wagoodman/dive.summary: 探索 Docker / OCI 镜像各层内容的工具，能查看每层变更并提示浪费的空间，帮助缩小镜像体积。
wagoodman/dive.summary_en: A tool for exploring the contents of each layer of a Docker or OCI image, showing per-layer changes and wasted space to help shrink image size.

vuejs/core.summary: Vue 3 的核心仓库，渐进式 JavaScript 前端框架，采用组合式 API 与响应式系统，可从简单页面逐步扩展到大型应用。
vuejs/core.summary_en: The core repository of Vue 3, a progressive JavaScript front-end framework with the Composition API and a reactivity system that scales from simple pages to large apps.

psf/requests.summary: Python 最常用的 HTTP 库，接口简洁优雅，处理会话、认证、Cookie 与 JSON 等常见需求。
psf/requests.summary_en: The most widely used HTTP library for Python, with a clean, elegant API covering sessions, authentication, cookies, and JSON.

ElemeFE/element.summary: 饿了么开源的 Vue 2 桌面端 UI 组件库（Element UI），Vue 3 版本请使用社区维护的 Element Plus。
ElemeFE/element.summary_en: Eleme's open-source Vue 2 desktop UI toolkit (Element UI); for Vue 3, use the community-maintained Element Plus.

google/material-design-icons.summary: Google 官方的 Material 图标集，包含现行的 Material Symbols（可变字体）和经典的 Material Icons。
google/material-design-icons.summary_en: Google's official Material icon sets, including the current Material Symbols built on variable fonts and the classic Material Icons.

necolas/normalize.css.summary: CSS 重置的现代替代方案，保留有用的浏览器默认样式并抹平跨浏览器差异。
necolas/normalize.css.summary_en: A modern alternative to CSS resets that preserves useful browser defaults while smoothing out cross-browser inconsistencies.

vsouza/awesome-ios.summary: iOS 生态精选清单，收录 Objective-C 和 Swift 项目，按架构、网络、缓存、图表、认证等分类。
vsouza/awesome-ios.summary_en: A curated list of the iOS ecosystem with Objective-C and Swift projects, organized by architecture, networking, caching, charts, authentication, and more.

JetBrains/kotlin.summary: JetBrains 开发的 Kotlin 语言仓库，简洁的多平台语言，可编译到 JVM、JavaScript 和原生，是 Android 官方首选语言，也用于服务端。
JetBrains/kotlin.summary_en: The repository of Kotlin, JetBrains' concise multiplatform language that compiles to the JVM, JavaScript, and native code; it is Android's preferred language and is also used on the server.

jesseduffield/lazydocker.summary: Docker 与 docker-compose 的终端 UI，可在一个界面里查看容器、日志、资源占用并执行常见操作。
jesseduffield/lazydocker.summary_en: A terminal UI for Docker and docker-compose that shows containers, logs, and resource usage in one place and runs common operations.

ionic-team/ionic-framework.summary: 基于 Web Components 的跨平台 UI 工具包，用 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 一套代码构建 iOS、Android 与 PWA 应用，可搭配 Angular、React、Vue。
ionic-team/ionic-framework.summary_en: A cross-platform UI toolkit based on Web Components for building iOS, Android, and PWA apps from one HTML, CSS, and JavaScript codebase, usable with Angular, React, or Vue.

expo/expo.summary: 构建 React 原生通用应用的开源框架与平台，提供 SDK、开发工具和云构建服务，覆盖 Android、iOS 和 Web。
expo/expo.summary_en: An open-source framework and platform for building universal React native apps, with an SDK, tooling, and cloud build services covering Android, iOS, and the web.

etcd-io/etcd.summary: 分布式可靠键值存储，基于 Raft 共识，用于保存分布式系统的关键数据，是 Kubernetes 的核心组件。
etcd-io/etcd.summary_en: A distributed, reliable key-value store based on Raft consensus for the most critical data of distributed systems, and a core component of Kubernetes.

prettier/prettier.summary: 固执己见的代码格式化工具，解析代码后按统一风格重新输出，支持 JS / TS、CSS、HTML、Markdown、YAML 等多种语言。
prettier/prettier.summary_en: An opinionated code formatter that parses code and reprints it in a consistent style, supporting JS and TS, CSS, HTML, Markdown, YAML, and many other languages.

dbeaver/dbeaver.summary: 跨平台通用数据库客户端，支持数十种关系型与 NoSQL 数据库，带 SQL 编辑器、数据编辑、ER 图与导入导出功能。
dbeaver/dbeaver.summary_en: A cross-platform universal database client supporting dozens of relational and NoSQL databases, with a SQL editor, data editing, ER diagrams, and import and export.

google/guava.summary: Google 的 Java 核心库，提供集合扩展、不可变集合、缓存、并发、I/O、哈希等常用工具。
google/guava.summary_en: Google's core Java libraries, offering collection extensions, immutable collections, caching, concurrency, I/O, and hashing utilities.

jekyll/jekyll.summary: Ruby 编写的静态站点生成器，把 Markdown 和 Liquid 模板转成静态网站，是 GitHub Pages 的原生引擎。
jekyll/jekyll.summary_en: A static site generator written in Ruby that turns Markdown and Liquid templates into static websites; the native engine behind GitHub Pages.

charlax/professional-programming.summary: 面向软件工程师的学习资源合集，涵盖架构、可扩展性、数据库、测试、DevOps 与职业发展等主题。
charlax/professional-programming.summary_en: A collection of learning resources for software engineers covering architecture, scalability, databases, testing, DevOps, and career development.

DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped.summary: TypeScript 类型定义的社区仓库，为没有自带类型的 JavaScript 包提供 @types 声明文件。
DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped.summary_en: The community repository of TypeScript type definitions, providing @types declaration files for JavaScript packages that lack their own types.

cypress-io/cypress.summary: 面向浏览器应用的端到端与组件测试框架，测试与应用运行在同一浏览器中，提供时间旅行调试和自动重试。
cypress-io/cypress.summary_en: An end-to-end and component testing framework for browser apps, running tests in the same browser as the app, with time-travel debugging and automatic retries.

Semantic-Org/Semantic-UI.summary: 以自然语言命名理念设计的 UI 组件框架，提供五十多个组件、可主题化的 CSS 变量，类名读起来像句子。
Semantic-Org/Semantic-UI.summary_en: A UI component framework built around natural-language naming, with over fifty components and themeable CSS variables, so class names read like sentences.

TanStack/query.summary: 异步状态管理库，负责服务端数据的请求、缓存、同步与更新，提供 React、Vue、Solid、Svelte 等适配。
TanStack/query.summary_en: An async state-management library for fetching, caching, synchronizing, and updating server data, with adapters for React, Vue, Solid, and Svelte.

apple/container.summary: 苹果推出的 macOS 容器工具，用 Swift 编写、针对 Apple 芯片优化，把 Linux 容器作为轻量级虚拟机运行，兼容 OCI 镜像。
apple/container.summary_en: Apple's container tool for macOS, written in Swift and optimized for Apple silicon, running Linux containers as lightweight virtual machines with OCI image compatibility.

kelseyhightower/kubernetes-the-hard-way.summary: 手把手教程，不借助自动化脚本，从零一步步手工搭建 Kubernetes 集群，帮助理解各组件之间的关系。
kelseyhightower/kubernetes-the-hard-way.summary_en: A step-by-step tutorial that bootstraps a Kubernetes cluster by hand without automation scripts, to build an understanding of how its components fit together.

ClickHouse/ClickHouse.summary: 列式存储的实时分析型数据库，面向海量数据的聚合查询，查询速度极快，常用于日志和事件分析。
ClickHouse/ClickHouse.summary_en: A column-oriented real-time analytics database built for fast aggregate queries over huge datasets, commonly used for log and event analytics.

jgthms/bulma.summary: 基于 Flexbox 的现代 CSS 框架，纯 CSS 无 JavaScript，通过类名组合出响应式布局与常见组件。
jgthms/bulma.summary_en: A modern Flexbox-based CSS framework, pure CSS with no JavaScript, composing responsive layouts and common components from class names.

astral-sh/ruff.summary: 用 Rust 写的极速 Python Linter 和格式化工具，兼容 Flake8、Black 等规则，速度快 10 到 100 倍。
astral-sh/ruff.summary_en: An extremely fast Python linter and formatter written in Rust that implements rules from Flake8, Black, and others, 10 to 100 times faster than existing tools.

hashicorp/terraform.summary: 基础设施即代码工具，用声明式配置文件描述云资源，规划并安全地创建、变更和版本化基础设施，支持多云。
hashicorp/terraform.summary_en: An infrastructure-as-code tool that describes cloud resources in declarative configuration files and plans, creates, and versions infrastructure safely across many providers.

bigskysoftware/htmx.summary: 让 HTML 直接通过属性发起 AJAX、WebSocket 和 SSE 请求并做 CSS 过渡，无需写 JavaScript 就能做出现代交互，倾向于服务端渲染。
bigskysoftware/htmx.summary_en: Lets HTML use attributes to trigger AJAX, WebSockets, SSE, and CSS transitions, enabling modern interactions with little JavaScript and favoring server-rendered HTML.

akullpp/awesome-java.summary: Java 框架、库和软件精选清单，收录数百个项目，标注活跃度，按类别整理。
akullpp/awesome-java.summary_en: A curated list of Java frameworks, libraries, and software with hundreds of projects organized by category and marked with activity status.

iamkun/dayjs.summary: 仅 2KB 的不可变日期时间库，API 与 Moment.js 基本兼容，可通过插件扩展。
iamkun/dayjs.summary_en: A 2KB immutable date and time library with a Moment.js-compatible API, extensible through plugins.

type-challenges/type-challenges.summary: TypeScript 类型体操题库，带在线评测，通过练习掌握类型系统的进阶用法，从简单到极端难度分级。
type-challenges/type-challenges.summary_en: A collection of TypeScript type-system challenges with an online judge, graded from easy to extreme, for mastering advanced type-level programming.

brillout/awesome-react-components.summary: React 组件与库的精选清单，只收有实际价值的组件，按主题分类。
brillout/awesome-react-components.summary_en: A curated list of React components and libraries that solve real problems, organized by topic.

DavidHDev/react-bits.summary: 大型 React 动效组件合集，提供二百多个可自由定制的文字、背景、UI 与微交互动画，复制即用。
DavidHDev/react-bits.summary_en: A large collection of animated React components, with over 200 customizable effects for text, backgrounds, UI, and micro-interactions that you copy into your project.

ReactiveX/RxJava.summary: Java 虚拟机上的 Reactive Extensions 实现，用可观察序列组合异步和事件驱动程序，在 Android 开发中尤其常见。
ReactiveX/RxJava.summary_en: The JVM implementation of Reactive Extensions, composing asynchronous and event-driven programs with observable sequences, especially common in Android development.

moment/moment.summary: 经典 JavaScript 日期库，用于解析、校验、操作和格式化日期，目前处于维护模式，官方建议新项目考虑其他库。
moment/moment.summary_en: The classic JavaScript date library for parsing, validating, manipulating, and formatting dates; now in maintenance mode, with the maintainers suggesting alternatives for new projects.

nvm-windows/nvm.summary: Windows 版 Node.js 版本管理器，使用原生 Windows 安装包，第二版已全面重写。
nvm-windows/nvm.summary_en: A Node.js version manager for Windows with a native installer; version 2 is a full rewrite.

acmesh-official/acme.sh.summary: 纯 Unix Shell 实现的 ACME 客户端，用来自动申请和续期 Let's Encrypt 等机构的 SSL / TLS 证书，无需额外依赖。
acmesh-official/acme.sh.summary_en: A pure Unix shell ACME client for automating SSL and TLS certificates from Let's Encrypt and other authorities, with no extra dependencies.

prisma/orm.summary: 面向 Node.js 与 TypeScript 的新一代 ORM，用声明式 schema 生成类型安全的查询客户端，支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、MongoDB 等。
prisma/orm.summary_en: A next-generation ORM for Node.js and TypeScript that generates a type-safe query client from a declarative schema, supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, and more.

dypsilon/frontend-dev-bookmarks.summary: 人工整理的前端开发资源合集，按类别拆成多个小文件，方便浏览。
dypsilon/frontend-dev-bookmarks.summary_en: A manually curated collection of front-end development resources split by category into small files.

slab/quill.summary: 现代所见即所得富文本编辑器，强调兼容性和可扩展性，用 Delta 格式表示内容，支持自定义模块与主题。
slab/quill.summary_en: A modern WYSIWYG rich-text editor focused on compatibility and extensibility, representing content in the Delta format with custom modules and themes.

usebruno/bruno.summary: 开源 API 调试工具，集合以纯文本文件保存在本地并可用 Git 管理，定位为 Postman 和 Insomnia 的轻量替代品。
usebruno/bruno.summary_en: An open-source API client that stores collections as plain text files locally so they can be managed with Git, positioned as a lightweight alternative to Postman and Insomnia.

typescript-cheatsheets/react.summary: 面向有经验 React 开发者的 TypeScript 速查表，涵盖组件、hooks、事件与常见类型写法。
typescript-cheatsheets/react.summary_en: Cheat sheets for experienced React developers adopting TypeScript, covering components, hooks, events, and common typing patterns.

lysine-dev/okhttp.summary: Java、Kotlin 与 Android 上广泛使用的高效 HTTP 客户端，支持连接池、HTTP/2、透明压缩和拦截器。
lysine-dev/okhttp.summary_en: A widely used efficient HTTP client for Java, Kotlin, and Android with connection pooling, HTTP/2, transparent compression, and interceptors.

apache/airflow.summary: 以代码编写、调度和监控工作流的平台，用 Python 定义 DAG，是数据工程中最常用的编排工具之一。
apache/airflow.summary_en: A platform to author, schedule, and monitor workflows as code, defining DAGs in Python, and one of the most widely used orchestrators in data engineering.

serverless/serverless.summary: Serverless Framework，通过配置文件把应用部署到 AWS Lambda 等托管云服务，自动伸缩、空闲不计费。
serverless/serverless.summary_en: The Serverless Framework, deploying apps to managed cloud services such as AWS Lambda from configuration files, with automatic scaling and no cost when idle.

Asabeneh/30-Days-Of-JavaScript.summary: 30 天 JavaScript 学习挑战，按天讲解基础语法到 DOM、异步等主题，配有练习。
Asabeneh/30-Days-Of-JavaScript.summary_en: A 30-day JavaScript learning challenge that goes day by day from basic syntax to DOM and async topics, with exercises.

microsoft/monaco-editor.summary: VS Code 同款的浏览器代码编辑器组件，支持语法高亮、智能提示和多语言，可嵌入网页。
microsoft/monaco-editor.summary_en: The browser code editor that powers VS Code, embeddable in web pages with syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, and multi-language support.

LeCoupa/awesome-cheatsheets.summary: 常用编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表合集，每个主题浓缩成一个文件。
LeCoupa/awesome-cheatsheets.summary_en: Cheat sheets for popular programming languages, frameworks, and development tools, each topic condensed into a single file.

cli/cli.summary: GitHub 官方命令行工具 gh，在终端里处理 PR、Issue、Actions 和仓库操作，可与 git 配合使用。
cli/cli.summary_en: GitHub's official command-line tool gh, handling pull requests, issues, Actions, and repository operations from the terminal alongside git.

docker/awesome-compose.summary: Docker 官方的 Docker Compose 示例合集，演示如何用 compose 文件组合前端、后端、数据库等服务，可作为起步模板。
docker/awesome-compose.summary_en: Docker's official collection of Compose samples showing how to combine front end, back end, and database services in a compose file, usable as starter templates.

karanpratapsingh/system-design.summary: 大规模系统设计课程，讲解网络、数据库、缓存、消息队列、微服务等概念，并附案例，兼顾系统设计面试。
karanpratapsingh/system-design.summary_en: A large-scale system design course covering networking, databases, caching, queues, and microservices with case studies, useful for system design interviews.

DataTalksClub/data-engineering-zoomcamp.summary: 免费的 9 周数据工程课程，通过从零搭建端到端数据管道，学习云、Docker、Kafka、Spark、dbt 等。
DataTalksClub/data-engineering-zoomcamp.summary_en: A free 9-week data engineering course that builds an end-to-end data pipeline from scratch, covering cloud, Docker, Kafka, Spark, dbt, and more.

android/architecture-samples.summary: Google 官方的 Android 架构示例，用同一个 TODO 应用演示不同架构模式与工具的实现差异。
android/architecture-samples.summary_en: Google's official Android architecture samples, implementing the same TODO app to show the differences between architectural patterns and tools.

streamlit/streamlit.summary: 把 Python 脚本快速变成交互式 Web 应用的框架，用几行代码搭建数据看板和原型，无需前端知识。
streamlit/streamlit.summary_en: A framework that turns Python scripts into interactive web apps in minutes, building dashboards and prototypes without front-end knowledge.

fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template.summary: FastAPI 官方全栈模板，整合 FastAPI、SQLModel、PostgreSQL、React、Tailwind 与 Docker Compose，含认证、邮件和 CI 配置。
fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template.summary_en: The official FastAPI full-stack template combining FastAPI, SQLModel, PostgreSQL, React, Tailwind, and Docker Compose, with authentication, email, and CI configuration.

google/zx.summary: 用 JavaScript 编写更好用的 shell 脚本，封装 child_process，提供 $ 模板字符串、并行和错误处理。
google/zx.summary_en: A tool for writing better shell scripts in JavaScript, wrapping child_process with a $ template tag, parallel execution, and error handling.

Leaflet/Leaflet.summary: 轻量的移动友好交互式地图 JavaScript 库，核心小巧、插件丰富，是开源 Web 地图的常用选择。
Leaflet/Leaflet.summary_en: A lightweight, mobile-friendly JavaScript library for interactive maps with a small core and many plugins, a common choice for open-source web maps.

ColorlibHQ/AdminLTE.summary: 基于 Bootstrap 5 的免费后台管理面板模板，纯原生 JavaScript，响应式并高度可定制。
ColorlibHQ/AdminLTE.summary_en: A free admin dashboard template built on Bootstrap 5 with vanilla JavaScript, responsive and highly customizable.

jestjs/jest.summary: JavaScript 测试框架，开箱即用，提供快照测试、Mock、覆盖率和交互式监听模式，是 React 项目的常见选择。
jestjs/jest.summary_en: A JavaScript testing framework that works out of the box, with snapshot testing, mocking, coverage, and an interactive watch mode; a common choice for React projects.

grpc/grpc.summary: Google 开源的高性能 RPC 框架，基于 HTTP/2 和 Protocol Buffers，支持多语言客户端与服务端，适合微服务通信。
grpc/grpc.summary_en: Google's open-source high-performance RPC framework over HTTP/2 and Protocol Buffers with multi-language clients and servers, suited to microservice communication.

pyenv/pyenv.summary: 简单的 Python 版本管理工具，通过 shim 在多个 Python 版本间切换，遵循 Unix 单一职责风格。
pyenv/pyenv.summary_en: A simple Python version manager that switches between multiple Python versions through shims, following the Unix single-purpose tradition.

payloadcms/payload.summary: 基于 Next.js 的全栈框架和无头 CMS，用 TypeScript 配置生成后端、管理面板和 API，可嵌入现有 Next.js 项目。
payloadcms/payload.summary_en: A full-stack Next.js framework and headless CMS that generates a TypeScript back end, admin panel, and API from configuration and can be embedded in an existing Next.js app.

getsentry/sentry.summary: 开发者优先的错误追踪与性能监控平台，收集异常堆栈和性能数据，提供多语言 SDK，可自托管。
getsentry/sentry.summary_en: A developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring platform that collects stack traces and performance data, with SDKs for many languages; self-hostable.

react-hook-form/react-hook-form.summary: 高性能的 React 表单状态管理与校验库，基于 hooks 和非受控组件，重渲染少、体积小，也支持 React Native。
react-hook-form/react-hook-form.summary_en: A performant React form state and validation library based on hooks and uncontrolled inputs, with few re-renders and a small footprint, also supporting React Native.

sudheerj/reactjs-interview-questions.summary: 五百道 React 面试题及答案，涵盖组件、hooks、路由、Redux 等主题。
sudheerj/reactjs-interview-questions.summary_en: Around 500 React interview questions and answers covering components, hooks, routing, and Redux.

meteor/meteor.summary: JavaScript 全栈应用平台，前后端共用一套代码，内置实时数据同步和构建系统，默认搭配 MongoDB。
meteor/meteor.summary_en: A full-stack JavaScript app platform sharing code between client and server, with built-in real-time data sync and a build system, typically paired with MongoDB.

DataExpert-io/data-engineer-handbook.summary: 数据工程学习资源合集，汇总课程、书籍、工具和实战项目的链接。
DataExpert-io/data-engineer-handbook.summary_en: A collection of data engineering learning resources, linking to courses, books, tools, and hands-on projects.

Kong/kong.summary: 云原生 API 网关（现也支持 LLM 网关），基于 Nginx 与 Lua，提供路由、认证、限流和插件扩展。
Kong/kong.summary_en: A cloud-native API gateway, now also covering LLM traffic, built on Nginx and Lua with routing, authentication, rate limiting, and plugins.

apache/spark.summary: 面向大规模数据处理的统一分析引擎，提供 Scala、Java、Python 等 API，支持批处理、流处理、SQL 与机器学习。
apache/spark.summary_en: A unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing with APIs in Scala, Java, and Python, supporting batch and stream processing, SQL, and machine learning.

babel/babel.summary: JavaScript 编译器，把新语法转成旧环境可运行的代码，并支持 JSX、TypeScript 等转换，是前端构建链的基础组件。
babel/babel.summary_en: A JavaScript compiler that transforms newer syntax into code older environments can run, with JSX and TypeScript transforms, and a foundational part of front-end build chains.

colinhacks/zod.summary: TypeScript 优先的 schema 校验库，定义一次即可同时得到运行时校验和静态类型推断，常用于表单与 API 参数校验。
colinhacks/zod.summary_en: A TypeScript-first schema validation library where one definition gives both runtime validation and static type inference, commonly used for forms and API input.

parcel-bundler/parcel.summary: 零配置的 Web 应用打包工具，开箱即用支持多种资源类型和热更新，并可扩展到大型项目。
parcel-bundler/parcel.summary_en: A zero-configuration web app bundler that supports many asset types and hot reloading out of the box and scales to large projects.

streamich/react-use.summary: React Hooks 合集，提供传感器、UI、动画、状态等数十种常用 hook。
streamich/react-use.summary_en: A collection of React hooks covering sensors, UI, animation, and state, with dozens of commonly needed hooks.

yangshun/front-end-interview-handbook.summary: 前端面试准备手册，涵盖 JavaScript、HTML、CSS、系统设计与算法要点，由 GreatFrontEnd 团队维护。
yangshun/front-end-interview-handbook.summary_en: A front-end interview preparation handbook covering JavaScript, HTML, CSS, system design, and algorithms, maintained by the GreatFrontEnd team.

lysine-dev/retrofit.summary: 类型安全的 HTTP 客户端，用注解接口描述 REST API 并生成实现，广泛用于 Android 与 JVM 开发，基于 OkHttp。
lysine-dev/retrofit.summary_en: A type-safe HTTP client that turns annotated interfaces into REST API implementations, widely used on Android and the JVM and built on OkHttp.

astaxie/build-web-application-with-golan.summary: 《Go Web 编程》电子书，讲解用 Go 语言构建 Web 应用，涵盖路由、模板、数据库、安全与部署，提供多语言版本。
astaxie/build-web-application-with-golan.summary_en: The ebook on building web applications with Go, covering routing, templates, databases, security, and deployment, available in many languages.

alex/what-happens-when.summary: 回答「在浏览器输入 google.com 并回车后发生了什么」这道经典面试题，从键盘输入一路讲到页面渲染，涵盖 DNS、TCP、TLS、HTTP。
alex/what-happens-when.summary_en: An answer to the classic question of what happens when you type google.com into a browser, walking from keystroke to page render across DNS, TCP, TLS, and HTTP.

Unitech/pm2.summary: Node.js / Bun 生产环境进程管理器，内置负载均衡，支持守护进程、零停机重载、日志与监控。
Unitech/pm2.summary_en: A production process manager for Node.js and Bun with a built-in load balancer, keeping apps alive with zero-downtime reloads, logs, and monitoring.

saadeghi/daisyui.summary: Tailwind CSS 组件库，用语义类名（如 btn、card）提供预设样式和主题，减少冗长的原子类。
saadeghi/daisyui.summary_en: A Tailwind CSS component library that provides prebuilt styles and themes through semantic class names such as btn and card, cutting down long utility chains.

Alamofire/Alamofire.summary: Swift 的 HTTP 网络库，封装 URLSession，提供链式请求、响应序列化、认证和重试等功能，iOS 开发中的常用依赖。
Alamofire/Alamofire.summary_en: An HTTP networking library for Swift wrapping URLSession with chainable requests, response serialization, authentication, and retries; a staple dependency in iOS development.

fastlane/fastlane.summary: 自动化 iOS 与 Android 应用构建、截图、签名和发布的工具，用 Ruby 编写，用 Fastfile 串联流程。
fastlane/fastlane.summary_en: A tool that automates building, screenshots, code signing, and releasing iOS and Android apps, written in Ruby and driven by a Fastfile.

nolimits4web/swiper.summary: 现代移动触摸滑块（轮播）库，硬件加速动画，可用于网站、Web 应用与移动端，并提供 React、Vue 等组件。
nolimits4web/swiper.summary_en: A modern touch slider (carousel) library with hardware-accelerated transitions for websites, web apps, and mobile, with React and Vue components.

ashishps1/awesome-system-design-resource.summary: 免费的系统设计学习资源合集，用于学习系统设计概念和准备面试。
ashishps1/awesome-system-design-resource.summary_en: A collection of free system design resources for learning concepts and preparing for interviews.

psf/black.summary: 「毫不妥协」的 Python 代码格式化工具，几乎不留配置项，换来统一风格、确定性输出和更快的代码评审。
psf/black.summary_en: The uncompromising Python code formatter, with almost no options in exchange for consistent style, deterministic output, and faster code review.

tabler/tabler.summary: 基于 Bootstrap 5 的免费开源 HTML 仪表盘 UI 套件，提供丰富的页面模板和组件，含多个框架版本。
tabler/tabler.summary_en: A free open-source HTML dashboard UI kit built on Bootstrap 5, with many page templates and components and versions for several frameworks.

duckdb/duckdb.summary: 进程内的分析型 SQL 数据库，无需服务端，可直接查询 Parquet、CSV 等文件，SQL 方言丰富。
duckdb/duckdb.summary_en: An in-process analytical SQL database that needs no server and queries Parquet, CSV, and other files directly, with a rich SQL dialect.

hexojs/hexo.summary: 基于 Node.js 的快速博客框架，把 Markdown 生成静态网站，支持主题和插件，并可一键部署到 GitHub Pages 等。
hexojs/hexo.summary_en: A fast Node.js blog framework that generates static sites from Markdown, with themes and plugins and one-command deployment to GitHub Pages and others.

dcloudio/uni-app.summary: 用 Vue.js 开发所有前端应用的跨平台框架，一套代码可发布到 iOS、Android、Web 以及微信、支付宝等各类小程序。
dcloudio/uni-app.summary_en: A cross-platform framework that uses Vue.js to build all front-end apps, publishing one codebase to iOS, Android, the web, and mini-programs such as WeChat and Alipay.

apache/dubbo.summary: Apache Dubbo 的 Java 实现，一个 RPC 与微服务框架，提供服务发现、负载均衡、流量治理，也有多语言实现。
apache/dubbo.summary_en: The Java implementation of Apache Dubbo, an RPC and microservice framework with service discovery, load balancing, and traffic governance, plus implementations in other languages.

yarnpkg/yarn.summary: Yarn 1.x 的源码仓库，JavaScript 包管理器，1.x 已进入冻结状态，新版本在 yarnpkg/berry 中开发。
yarnpkg/yarn.summary_en: The source of Yarn 1.x, a JavaScript package manager; the 1.x line is frozen and new development happens in yarnpkg/berry.

nwjs/nw.js.summary: 基于 Chromium 与 Node.js 的应用运行时（原名 node-webkit），可用 HTML 和 JavaScript 编写桌面应用并直接调用 Node 模块。
nwjs/nw.js.summary_en: An app runtime based on Chromium and Node.js (formerly node-webkit) for writing desktop apps in HTML and JavaScript with direct access to Node modules.

styled-components/styled-components.summary: React 的 CSS-in-JS 库，用带样式的标签模板创建组件，支持主题、服务端渲染和 React Native。
styled-components/styled-components.summary_en: A CSS-in-JS library for React that creates components from styled tagged templates, with theming, server-side rendering, and React Native support.

vuetifyjs/vuetify.summary: Vue 的 Material Design 组件框架，提供丰富的预制组件、主题系统和栅格。
vuetifyjs/vuetify.summary_en: A Vue component framework implementing Material Design, with a rich set of ready-made components, theming, and a grid system.

bailicangdu/vue2-elm.summary: 基于 Vue 2 与 Vuex 的 45 页大型单页应用，仿饿了么外卖，含购物车、登录注册等复杂交互，用作 Vue 实战示例。
bailicangdu/vue2-elm.summary_en: A large 45-page single-page app built with Vue 2 and Vuex, modeled on a food-delivery service with carts, login, and other complex interactions, used as a Vue practice project.

appsmithorg/appsmith.summary: 开源低代码平台，用来搭建管理后台、内部工具和仪表盘，可连接二十多种数据库和任意 API，可自托管。
appsmithorg/appsmith.summary_en: An open-source low-code platform for building admin panels, internal tools, and dashboards, connecting to 25+ databases and any API; self-hostable.

trpc/trpc.summary: 端到端类型安全的 API 方案，前端直接调用服务端函数并获得类型推断，无需 schema 或代码生成。
trpc/trpc.summary_en: An end-to-end type-safe API approach where the client calls server procedures with inferred types, with no schemas or code generation.

chakra-ui/chakra-ui.summary: 面向 SaaS 产品的 React 组件系统，组件可访问、可组合，支持主题和样式属性，兼容 Next.js RSC。
chakra-ui/chakra-ui.summary_en: A React component system for SaaS products with accessible, composable components, theming, and style props, compatible with Next.js RSC.

bradtraversy/50projects50days.summary: 50 多个 HTML / CSS / JavaScript 小项目合集，配套 50 天课程，适合边做边练前端基础。
bradtraversy/50projects50days.summary_en: More than 50 small HTML, CSS, and JavaScript projects accompanying a 50-day course, good for practicing front-end basics by building.

php/php-src.summary: PHP 解释器源码，一门专为 Web 开发设计的通用脚本语言，支撑 WordPress、Laravel 等大量网站与框架。
php/php-src.summary_en: The source of the PHP interpreter, a general-purpose scripting language designed for web development that powers WordPress, Laravel, and a great many sites and frameworks.

gofiber/fiber.summary: 受 Express 启发的 Go Web 框架，构建在 Fasthttp 之上，强调零内存分配和开发效率。
gofiber/fiber.summary_en: An Express-inspired Go web framework built on Fasthttp, emphasizing zero memory allocation and developer productivity.

evanw/esbuild.summary: 用 Go 写的极速 JavaScript / TypeScript 打包器和压缩器，比传统工具快一到两个数量级，是 Vite 等工具的底层组件。
evanw/esbuild.summary_en: An extremely fast JavaScript and TypeScript bundler and minifier written in Go, one to two orders of magnitude faster than older tools and a building block of tools such as Vite.

Kong/insomnia.summary: 开源跨平台 API 客户端，支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC，可选云端、本地或 Git 存储。
Kong/insomnia.summary_en: An open-source, cross-platform API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, SSE, and gRPC, with cloud, local, or Git storage.

go-gorm/gorm.summary: Go 语言的全功能 ORM，支持关联、钩子、事务、预加载、迁移和多种数据库，接口对开发者友好。
go-gorm/gorm.summary_en: A full-featured ORM for Go with associations, hooks, transactions, preloading, migrations, and multiple databases, with a developer-friendly API.

halo-dev/halo.summary: Java 编写的开源建站工具，可搭建博客、知识库、企业官网和商城，提供插件与主题体系，可用 Docker 快速部署。
halo-dev/halo.summary_en: An open-source site-building tool written in Java for blogs, knowledge bases, corporate sites, and stores, with a plugin and theme system and quick Docker deployment.

videojs/video.js.summary: 开源 HTML5 视频播放器与框架，支持 HLS / DASH、字幕、插件和主题，可跨浏览器播放。
videojs/video.js.summary_en: An open-source HTML5 video player and framework with HLS and DASH, captions, plugins, and themes, playing across browsers.

drawdb-io/drawdb.summary: 浏览器中的数据库实体关系图编辑器，可视化设计表结构并导出 SQL，也支持从 SQL 生成图。
drawdb-io/drawdb.summary_en: A browser-based database ER diagram editor for designing schemas visually and exporting SQL, with SQL-to-diagram import.

freeCodeCamp/devdocs.summary: API 文档浏览器，把多种开发文档整合在统一界面中，支持即时搜索、离线使用和深色主题。
freeCodeCamp/devdocs.summary_en: An API documentation browser that combines many developer docs in one interface with instant search, offline support, and a dark theme.

YunaiV/ruoyi-vue-pro.summary: 基于 Spring Boot、MyBatis Plus 与 Vue 的后台管理系统（RuoYi-Vue 的 Pro 版），含 RBAC 权限、多租户、工作流、支付、商城等模块，全部开源。
YunaiV/ruoyi-vue-pro.summary_en: A back-office management system on Spring Boot, MyBatis Plus, and Vue (the Pro edition of RuoYi-Vue) with RBAC, multi-tenancy, workflows, payments, and commerce modules, fully open source.

google/leveldb.summary: Google 的快速键值存储库，提供按键有序的字符串映射，作为嵌入式存储引擎被多个数据库借用，目前仅有限维护。
google/leveldb.summary_en: Google's fast key-value storage library that provides an ordered string-to-string mapping, reused as an embedded storage engine by many databases; now only lightly maintained.

DioxusLabs/dioxus.summary: Rust 全栈应用框架，用一套代码构建 Web、桌面和移动应用，提供热重载、服务端函数与类似 React 的组件模型。
DioxusLabs/dioxus.summary_en: A Rust full-stack app framework that builds web, desktop, and mobile apps from one codebase, with hot reload, server functions, and a React-like component model.

umami-software/umami.summary: 注重隐私的网站分析平台，无需 Cookie，统计流量、活动、行为与转化，可自托管，作为 Google Analytics 的替代品。
umami-software/umami.summary_en: A privacy-first web analytics platform that needs no cookies and tracks traffic, campaigns, behavior, and conversions; self-hostable as an alternative to Google Analytics.

preactjs/preact.summary: 仅几 KB 的 React 轻量替代，保持相同的现代 API（hooks、组件、虚拟 DOM），可通过兼容层使用 React 生态。
preactjs/preact.summary_en: A tiny React alternative of a few kilobytes that keeps the same modern API (hooks, components, virtual DOM) and can use the React ecosystem through a compatibility layer.

ant-design/ant-design-pro.summary: 基于 Ant Design 的企业级中后台 React 脚手架，内置布局、路由、权限和数据流方案与常见业务页面。
ant-design/ant-design-pro.summary_en: An enterprise back-office React scaffold based on Ant Design, with built-in layout, routing, permissions, data flow, and common business pages.

Dogfalo/materialize.summary: 基于 Material Design 的 CSS 框架，提供组件、栅格和动效，现已停止活跃维护。
Dogfalo/materialize.summary_en: A CSS framework based on Material Design with components, a grid, and animations; no longer actively maintained.

portainer/portainer.summary: Docker、Swarm、Podman 和 Kubernetes 的轻量容器管理界面，可视化管理容器、镜像、卷和网络。
portainer/portainer.summary_en: A lightweight container management UI for Docker, Swarm, Podman, and Kubernetes, visually managing containers, images, volumes, and networks.

httpie/cli.summary: 面向人类的命令行 HTTP 客户端，语法直观，内置 JSON 支持、着色输出、会话与下载，适合调试 API。
httpie/cli.summary_en: A human-friendly command-line HTTP client with intuitive syntax, built-in JSON support, colored output, sessions, and downloads, suited to API debugging.

ueberdosis/tiptap.summary: 无头（headless）富文本编辑框架，基于 ProseMirror，自身不带界面，通过扩展定制，支持 React、Vue 等。
ueberdosis/tiptap.summary_en: A headless rich-text editor framework built on ProseMirror that ships no UI of its own and is customized through extensions, working with React, Vue, and more.

xyflow/xyflow.summary: 构建节点式界面的库，包含 React Flow 和 Svelte Flow，用于流程图、工作流编辑器和可视化编排，开箱即用且高度可定制。
xyflow/xyflow.summary_en: Libraries for building node-based UIs, including React Flow and Svelte Flow, used for flowcharts, workflow editors, and visual orchestration, ready out of the box and highly customizable.

dotnet/aspnetcore.summary: 微软的跨平台 .NET Web 框架，用于构建 Web 应用、API、实时通信（SignalR）和微服务，可运行在 Windows、macOS、Linux。
dotnet/aspnetcore.summary_en: Microsoft's cross-platform .NET web framework for building web apps, APIs, real-time services (SignalR), and microservices on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

harness/harness.summary: 一体化开发者平台，集代码托管、CI/CD 流水线、云开发环境和制品库于一身，可自托管。
harness/harness.summary_en: An end-to-end developer platform combining code hosting, CI/CD pipelines, cloud development environments, and artifact registries; self-hostable.

istio/istio.summary: 服务网格，以透明方式叠加在分布式应用之上，统一提供流量管理、安全通信和可观测性。
istio/istio.summary_en: A service mesh that layers transparently onto distributed applications, providing uniform traffic management, secure communication, and observability.

docker/compose.summary: 用 YAML 文件定义并运行多容器应用的工具，一条命令启动整套服务，常用于本地开发与小规模部署。
docker/compose.summary_en: A tool for defining and running multi-container applications from a YAML file, starting a whole stack with one command, commonly used for local development and small deployments.

PhilJay/MPAndroidChart.summary: Android 图表库，支持折线、柱状、饼图、雷达图与 K 线，提供缩放、拖动和动画，现已用 Kotlin 重写并提供 Compose 模块。
PhilJay/MPAndroidChart.summary_en: An Android charting library with line, bar, pie, radar, and candlestick charts plus zooming, dragging, and animation, now rewritten in Kotlin with a Compose module.

directus/directus.summary: 把任意 SQL 数据库变成无头 CMS 和管理后台，即时生成 REST 与 GraphQL API，提供可视化工作室与权限管理。
directus/directus.summary_en: Turns any SQL database into a headless CMS and admin app, generating instant REST and GraphQL APIs with a visual studio and permission management.

NervJS/taro.summary: 开放式跨端跨框架方案，用 React、Vue 等开发，可编译为微信、支付宝、京东等小程序以及 H5 和 React Native 应用。
NervJS/taro.summary_en: An open cross-platform, cross-framework solution that lets you write in React or Vue and compile to mini-programs on WeChat, Alipay, JD, and others, as well as H5 and React Native apps.

eugenp/tutorials.summary: Baeldung 教程配套的示例代码仓库，涵盖 Spring Boot、Java 核心、微服务、测试等大量主题的可运行示例。
eugenp/tutorials.summary_en: The companion code repository for Baeldung tutorials, with runnable examples on Spring Boot, core Java, microservices, testing, and many other topics.

markedjs/marked.summary: 为速度设计的 Markdown 解析与编译器，可在浏览器和 Node.js 中把 Markdown 转成 HTML，支持扩展。
markedjs/marked.summary_en: A Markdown parser and compiler built for speed that converts Markdown to HTML in browsers and Node.js, with extension support.

fastify/fastify.summary: 高性能低开销的 Node.js Web 框架，提供基于 JSON Schema 的校验与序列化、插件体系和完善的日志。
fastify/fastify.summary_en: A fast, low-overhead Node.js web framework with JSON Schema-based validation and serialization, a plugin system, and built-in logging.

keycloak/keycloak.summary: 开源身份与访问管理系统，提供单点登录、OIDC、SAML、社交登录、用户联邦和细粒度授权。
keycloak/keycloak.summary_en: An open-source identity and access management system offering single sign-on, OIDC, SAML, social login, user federation, and fine-grained authorization.

veggiemonk/awesome-docker.summary: Docker 资源与项目精选清单，涵盖工具、教程、镜像、编排与安全等。
veggiemonk/awesome-docker.summary_en: A curated list of Docker resources and projects covering tools, tutorials, images, orchestration, and security.

GorvGoyl/Clone-Wars.summary: 一百多个热门网站（Airbnb、Netflix、Spotify 等）的开源克隆项目合集，附源码、演示、技术栈与 star 数，可作全栈练手参考。
GorvGoyl/Clone-Wars.summary_en: A collection of 100+ open-source clones of popular sites such as Airbnb, Netflix, and Spotify, with source links, demos, tech stacks, and star counts, useful as full-stack practice references.

pnpm/pnpm.summary: 快速且节省磁盘的 Node.js 包管理器，用内容寻址存储和硬链接共享依赖，并原生支持 monorepo 工作区。
pnpm/pnpm.summary_en: A fast, disk-efficient Node.js package manager that shares dependencies through a content-addressable store and hard links, with native monorepo workspaces.

typeorm/typeorm.summary: 面向 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 的 ORM，支持 Active Record 与 Data Mapper 模式，覆盖 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite 等多种数据库，也能在浏览器与移动端运行。
typeorm/typeorm.summary_en: An ORM for TypeScript and JavaScript supporting Active Record and Data Mapper patterns across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and more, and runnable in browsers and mobile platforms.

date-fns/date-fns.summary: 模块化的 JavaScript 日期工具库，提供数百个纯函数，支持 tree-shaking，v4 起原生支持时区。
date-fns/date-fns.summary_en: A modular JavaScript date utility library with hundreds of pure functions, tree-shakable, with first-class time zone support since v4.

open-guides/og-aws.summary: 亚马逊云（AWS）实用指南，按服务整理经验、陷阱和最佳实践，偏重实战而非官方文档。
open-guides/og-aws.summary_en: A practical guide to Amazon Web Services organized by service, with experience, pitfalls, and best practices that complement rather than repeat the official docs.

wailsapp/wails.summary: 用 Go 与 Web 技术构建桌面应用的框架，前端用任意 Web 框架，后端 Go 方法可直接被前端调用。
wailsapp/wails.summary_en: A framework for building desktop apps with Go and web technologies, using any web front-end framework and letting the front end call Go methods directly.

SheetJS/sheetjs.summary: JavaScript 电子表格读写工具包，可在浏览器与 Node.js 中解析和生成 Excel、CSV 等格式，社区版在 Apache 2.0 下开源；代码已迁至新的官方仓库。
SheetJS/sheetjs.summary_en: A JavaScript spreadsheet toolkit for parsing and writing Excel, CSV, and other formats in browsers and Node.js, with the community edition under Apache 2.0; development has moved to a new official repository.

hashicorp/vault.summary: 密钥管理、加密即服务和特权访问管理工具，集中存储和动态生成凭据、证书与令牌。
hashicorp/vault.summary_en: A tool for secrets management, encryption as a service, and privileged access management, centrally storing and dynamically generating credentials, certificates, and tokens.

solidjs/solid.summary: 声明式 JavaScript UI 库，不用虚拟 DOM，把模板编译为真实 DOM 节点并用细粒度响应式更新，性能突出。
solidjs/solid.summary_en: A declarative JavaScript UI library that skips the virtual DOM, compiling templates to real DOM nodes with fine-grained reactive updates for high performance.

lerna/lerna.summary: 管理并发布同一仓库中多个 JavaScript / TypeScript 包的构建系统，现由 Nx 团队维护。
lerna/lerna.summary_en: A build system for managing and publishing multiple JavaScript and TypeScript packages from one repository, now maintained by the Nx team.

slatedocs/slate.summary: 静态 API 文档生成器，输出三栏式漂亮文档，曾被 NASA、Sony 等团队使用，现已少有更新。
slatedocs/slate.summary_en: A static API documentation generator with a polished three-column layout, once used by teams such as NASA and Sony and now rarely updated.

drizzle-team/drizzle-orm.summary: 轻量的 TypeScript ORM，用类 SQL 的类型安全查询构建器和迁移工具，主打无运行时开销，支持多种数据库和边缘运行时。
drizzle-team/drizzle-orm.summary_en: A lightweight TypeScript ORM with a SQL-like type-safe query builder and migration tooling, designed for minimal runtime overhead across many databases and edge runtimes.

alan2207/bulletproof-react.summary: 面向生产的 React 应用架构示例，展示项目结构、状态管理、测试、性能和安全等方面的最佳实践。
alan2207/bulletproof-react.summary_en: A production-oriented React application architecture example showing best practices for project structure, state management, testing, performance, and security.

refinedev/refine.summary: 面向 CRUD 密集型应用的 React 元框架，用来构建内部工具、管理后台和 B2B 应用，介于低代码与从零开发之间。
refinedev/refine.summary_en: A React meta-framework for CRUD-heavy apps, used to build internal tools, admin panels, and B2B apps, sitting between low-code and building from scratch.

airbnb/lottie-android.summary: Airbnb 的动画库，解析 After Effects 通过 Bodymovin 导出的 JSON 动画并原生渲染，覆盖 Android、iOS、Web 和 React Native。
airbnb/lottie-android.summary_en: Airbnb's animation library that parses After Effects animations exported as JSON with Bodymovin and renders them natively across Android, iOS, web, and React Native.

jondot/awesome-react-native.summary: React Native 库、工具和学习资源的精选清单，条目经过维护与相关性检查。
jondot/awesome-react-native.summary_en: A curated list of React Native libraries, tools, and learning resources, with entries checked for maintenance and relevance.

koajs/koa.summary: 由 Express 团队打造的 Node.js 中间件框架，基于 async 函数，核心极小，用洋葱模型组织中间件。
koajs/koa.summary_en: A Node.js middleware framework from the Express team, built on async functions with a tiny core and an onion-style middleware model.

opentofu/opentofu.summary: Terraform 的开源分支，在 Terraform 改用非开源许可后由社区发起，用声明式配置管理云基础设施，由 Linux 基金会托管。
opentofu/opentofu.summary_en: The open-source fork of Terraform, started by the community after Terraform moved to a non-open-source license, managing cloud infrastructure declaratively under the Linux Foundation.

alvarotrigo/fullPage.js.summary: 创建全屏滚动网页的插件，支持分区滚动、导航点和响应式，有 Vue、React、Angular 封装。
alvarotrigo/fullPage.js.summary_en: A plugin for full-screen scrolling pages with section snapping, navigation dots, and responsive behavior, with Vue, React, and Angular wrappers.

typicode/husky.summary: 让 Git 钩子易用的工具，在 commit、push 前自动运行 lint、测试等脚本，团队共享。
typicode/husky.summary_en: A tool that makes Git hooks easy, running scripts such as lint and tests automatically before commit or push and sharing them across a team.

nativefier/nativefier.summary: 一条命令把任意网页打包成桌面应用（基于 Electron），已不再维护。
nativefier/nativefier.summary_en: Packs any web page into a desktop app with one command (based on Electron); no longer maintained.

sahat/hackathon-starter.summary: Node.js Web 应用样板，预置 Express、多种 OAuth 登录、MongoDB 和常见第三方 API 示例，为黑客松缩短起步时间。
sahat/hackathon-starter.summary_en: A Node.js web application boilerplate with Express, many OAuth logins, MongoDB, and examples for common third-party APIs, built to shorten setup time at hackathons.

netty/netty.summary: 事件驱动的异步网络应用框架，为 Java 提供高性能的 NIO 通信基础，是众多 RPC、网关和中间件的底层。
netty/netty.summary_en: An event-driven asynchronous network application framework that gives Java a high-performance NIO foundation, underlying many RPC frameworks, gateways, and middleware.

seaweedfs/seaweedfs.summary: 分布式存储系统，可存储数十亿文件并快速读取，提供 S3 兼容对象存储、文件系统等接口，易于水平扩展。
seaweedfs/seaweedfs.summary_en: A distributed storage system that stores billions of files and serves them fast, exposing S3-compatible object storage and file system interfaces with easy horizontal scaling.

sorrycc/awesome-javascript.summary: 浏览器端 JavaScript 库与资源精选清单，涵盖包管理、打包、UI、测试等分类。
sorrycc/awesome-javascript.summary_en: A curated list of browser-side JavaScript libraries and resources covering package managers, bundlers, UI, testing, and more.

bumptech/glide.summary: Android 图片加载与缓存库，封装媒体解码、内存与磁盘缓存，重点优化列表滚动的流畅度。
bumptech/glide.summary_en: An Android image loading and caching library that wraps media decoding and memory and disk caching, with a focus on smooth list scrolling.

unknwon/the-way-to-go_ZH_CN.summary: 《The Way to Go》中文译本，名为《Go 入门指南》，系统介绍 Go 语言语法、并发与标准库。
unknwon/the-way-to-go_ZH_CN.summary_en: The Chinese translation of The Way to Go, an introduction to the Go language's syntax, concurrency, and standard library.

laravel/framework.summary: Laravel 框架核心代码仓库，包含路由、Eloquent ORM、队列、缓存、验证等核心组件，用于开发 Laravel 本身。
laravel/framework.summary_en: The core code repository of the Laravel framework, containing routing, the Eloquent ORM, queues, caching, validation, and other core components for developing Laravel itself.

qishibo/AnotherRedisDesktopManager.summary: Redis 桌面图形客户端，跨平台，加载海量 key 时依然稳定，支持集群与多种数据类型查看。
qishibo/AnotherRedisDesktopManager.summary_en: A cross-platform Redis desktop GUI client that stays stable when loading massive key sets, with cluster support and viewers for many data types.

derailed/k9s.summary: Kubernetes 的终端 UI，用键盘在集群中导航、观察和管理资源，比 kubectl 更高效直观。
derailed/k9s.summary_en: A terminal UI for Kubernetes that lets you navigate, observe, and manage cluster resources from the keyboard, more efficient and intuitive than raw kubectl.

backstage/backstage.summary: 构建开发者门户的开放框架，聚合服务目录、模板、文档与插件，统一团队的开发与部署入口。
backstage/backstage.summary_en: An open framework for building developer portals that aggregates a service catalog, templates, docs, and plugins into a single entry point for engineering workflows.

SeleniumHQ/selenium.summary: 浏览器自动化框架及生态，通过 WebDriver 协议驱动各类浏览器，支持多种语言，是 Web 端到端测试的老牌方案。
SeleniumHQ/selenium.summary_en: A browser automation framework and ecosystem that drives browsers through the WebDriver protocol with bindings for many languages, the long-standing option for web end-to-end testing.

jdx/mise.summary: 统一管理开发工具版本、环境变量和任务的工具，可替代 nvm、pyenv、asdf 等多个版本管理器。
jdx/mise.summary_en: A tool that unifies management of dev tool versions, environment variables, and tasks, replacing multiple version managers such as nvm, pyenv, and asdf.

jaredpalmer/formik.summary: React 表单库，处理表单状态、校验、提交和错误提示，减少样板代码。
jaredpalmer/formik.summary_en: A React form library that handles form state, validation, submission, and error display with less boilerplate.

python-poetry/poetry.summary: Python 依赖管理与打包工具，用 pyproject.toml 声明依赖，生成锁文件并支持构建与发布。
python-poetry/poetry.summary_en: A Python dependency management and packaging tool that declares dependencies in pyproject.toml, generates lock files, and supports building and publishing.

NginxProxyManager/nginx-proxy-manager.summary: 带图形界面的 Nginx 反向代理管理 Docker 镜像，无需了解 Nginx 配置即可转发站点并自动申请免费 SSL 证书。
