hollischuang/toBeTopJavaer.summary_en: A Java engineer knowledge map and interview question collection covering fundamentals, concurrency, the JVM, frameworks, databases, and distributed systems, available to read online.

iluwatar/java-design-patterns.summary: 用 Java 实现的设计模式集合，每个模式包含意图、适用场景、类图和示例代码，并覆盖多种企业与并发相关模式。
iluwatar/java-design-patterns.summary_en: A collection of design patterns implemented in Java, each with its intent, applicability, class diagram, and example code, including many enterprise and concurrency patterns.

nilbuild/design-patterns-for-humans.summary: 用尽量通俗的语言与现实类比讲解创建型、结构型和行为型设计模式，附 PHP 示例代码。
nilbuild/design-patterns-for-humans.summary_en: An ultra-simplified explanation of creational, structural, and behavioral design patterns using plain language and real-world analogies, with PHP code examples.

faif/python-patterns.summary: Python 设计模式与惯用法合集，按创建型、结构型、行为型等分类给出可运行的示例代码，并强调各模式的取舍。
faif/python-patterns.summary_en: A collection of Python design patterns and idioms, grouped into creational, structural, behavioral, and other categories with runnable examples and notes on each pattern's trade-offs.

tmrts/go-patterns.summary: Go 语言设计模式、技巧与惯用法的精选合集，按创建型、结构型、行为型、并发等分类给出代码示例。
tmrts/go-patterns.summary_en: A curated collection of design patterns, recipes, and idioms for Go, grouped into creational, structural, behavioral, and concurrency patterns with code samples.

DesignPatternsPHP/DesignPatternsPHP.summary: 用 PHP 8 实现的常见设计模式示例，每个模式附 UML 图、代码和测试，并强调何时选用哪种模式。
DesignPatternsPHP/DesignPatternsPHP.summary_en: Sample implementations of common design patterns in PHP 8, each with a UML diagram, code, and tests, with emphasis on when to apply which pattern.

dwmkerr/hacker-laws.summary: 开发者常用的定律、理论、原则与模式合集，如 Amdahl 定律、Brooks 定律、CAP 定理、康威定律等，逐条给出解释与延伸阅读。
dwmkerr/hacker-laws.summary_en: A collection of laws, theories, principles, and patterns useful to developers, such as Amdahl's law, Brooks' law, the CAP theorem, and Conway's law, each with an explanation and further reading.

google/styleguide.summary: Google 内部使用并开源的各语言代码风格指南索引，涵盖 C++、Java、Python、Go、Shell、JavaScript 等，并提供 Lint 配置。
google/styleguide.summary_en: An index of the code style guides Google uses and has open-sourced for languages such as C++, Java, Python, Go, shell, and JavaScript, along with lint configurations.

isocpp/CppCoreGuidelines.summary: 由 Bjarne Stroustrup 等主导的 C++ 核心指南，给出经过验证的编码规则与最佳实践，覆盖接口、资源管理、并发、性能与类型安全。
isocpp/CppCoreGuidelines.summary_en: The C++ Core Guidelines led by Bjarne Stroustrup, a set of proven rules and best practices covering interfaces, resource management, concurrency, performance, and type safety.

alibaba/p3c.summary: 阿里巴巴 Java 开发手册及其 PMD 规则实现和 IDE 插件，整合了集团多年的编码规范，覆盖命名、并发、异常、数据库与工程结构。
alibaba/p3c.summary_en: Alibaba's Java Coding Guidelines with a PMD rule implementation and IDE plugins, consolidating the group's years of coding practice across naming, concurrency, exceptions, databases, and project structure.

excalidraw/excalidraw.summary: 开源的手绘风虚拟白板，可协作、端到端加密，用于绘制图表与线框图，编辑器也以 npm 包形式提供，可嵌入其他应用。
excalidraw/excalidraw.summary_en: An open-source hand-drawn-style virtual whiteboard for diagrams and wireframes, collaborative and end-to-end encrypted, whose editor is also published as an npm package for embedding in other apps.

mermaid-js/mermaid.summary: 用类 Markdown 的文本生成流程图、时序图、甘特图等图表的 JavaScript 库，可在文档与网页中直接渲染，并提供在线编辑器。
mermaid-js/mermaid.summary_en: A JavaScript library that renders flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, and other diagrams from Markdown-like text in documents and web pages, with a live editor.

pixijs/pixijs.summary: 面向网页的 2D 渲染库，支持 WebGL 与 WebGPU，提供资源加载、触控交互、文本、矢量绘制、滤镜与混合模式。
pixijs/pixijs.summary_en: A 2D rendering library for the web supporting WebGL and WebGPU, with asset loading, touch interaction, text rendering, vector drawing, filters, and blend modes.

BabylonJS/Babylon.js.summary: 基于 JavaScript / TypeScript 的 3D 渲染与游戏引擎，支持 WebGL 与 WebGPU，提供场景、材质、物理、XR 与配套的 Playground。
BabylonJS/Babylon.js.summary_en: A 3D rendering and game engine for JavaScript and TypeScript supporting WebGL and WebGPU, with scenes, materials, physics, XR, and an accompanying playground.

processing/p5.js.summary: 面向创意编程的客户端 JavaScript 库，基于 Processing 的理念，提供画布绘制、交互、声音与 DOM 操作，适合设计师与初学者。
processing/p5.js.summary_en: A client-side JavaScript library for creative coding based on the ideas of Processing, offering canvas drawing, interaction, sound, and DOM manipulation for designers and beginners.

AykutSarac/jsoncrack.com.summary: 把 JSON、YAML、XML、CSV 转成可交互图形的开源可视化工具，可格式化、校验、转换格式、生成 Schema 并导出图片。
AykutSarac/jsoncrack.com.summary_en: An open-source tool that turns JSON, YAML, XML, and CSV into interactive graphs, with formatting, validation, format conversion, schema generation, and image export.

matplotlib/matplotlib.summary: Python 的综合绘图库，可创建静态、动画和交互式图表，输出多种出版级格式，并可嵌入脚本、Web 应用和 GUI 工具包。
matplotlib/matplotlib.summary_en: The comprehensive Python plotting library for static, animated, and interactive visualizations, producing publication-quality output in many formats and embeddable in scripts, web apps, and GUI toolkits.

plotly/dash.summary: 用纯 Python 构建数据应用与仪表盘的框架，基于 Plotly.js、React 和 Flask，把下拉框、滑块、图表与分析代码直接绑定。
plotly/dash.summary_en: A Python framework for building data apps and dashboards without JavaScript, built on Plotly.js, React, and Flask, binding UI elements such as dropdowns, sliders, and graphs directly to analysis code.

hakimel/reveal.js.summary: 基于 HTML 的演示文稿框架，支持嵌套幻灯片、Markdown、自动动画、PDF 导出、演讲者备注、LaTeX 与代码高亮。
hakimel/reveal.js.summary_en: An HTML presentation framework with nested slides, Markdown, auto-animate, PDF export, speaker notes, LaTeX, and syntax-highlighted code.

slidevjs/slidev.summary: 面向开发者的演示文稿工具，用 Markdown 编写，内置代码高亮与现场编码，可嵌入 Vue 组件，基于 Vite 并支持主题与演讲者模式。
slidevjs/slidev.summary_en: A presentation tool for developers that uses Markdown, with built-in code highlighting and live coding, embeddable Vue components, themes, and a presenter mode, built on Vite.

goldfire/howler.js.summary: 面向现代网页的 JavaScript 音频库，默认使用 Web Audio API 并回退到 HTML5 Audio，提供跨平台的音频播放、空间音效与音频精灵。
goldfire/howler.js.summary_en: A JavaScript audio library for the modern web that defaults to the Web Audio API and falls back to HTML5 Audio, providing cross-platform playback, spatial audio, and audio sprites.

remotion-dev/remotion.summary: 用 React 以编程方式制作视频的框架，以代码为视频的唯一来源，支持数据驱动、批量渲染和服务器端渲染。
remotion-dev/remotion.summary_en: A framework for making videos programmatically with React, treating code as the source of truth, with data-driven video, batch rendering, and server-side rendering.

mozilla/pdf.js.summary: 用 HTML5 构建的 PDF 阅读器，目标是提供基于 Web 标准的通用 PDF 解析与渲染平台，由社区驱动、Mozilla 支持，也用于 Firefox 内置阅读器。
mozilla/pdf.js.summary_en: A PDF viewer built with HTML5 that aims to be a general-purpose, web-standards-based platform for parsing and rendering PDFs, community-driven and supported by Mozilla.

cloudflare/pingora.summary: Cloudflare 用 Rust 编写的网络服务框架，用于构建快速、可靠、可编程的代理与网关，支持 HTTP/1/2、gRPC、WebSocket、TLS、负载均衡与热重载。
cloudflare/pingora.summary_en: Cloudflare's Rust framework for building fast, reliable, programmable network services such as proxies and gateways, with HTTP/1 and HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket, TLS, load balancing, and graceful reload.

go-gitea/gitea.summary: 用 Go 编写的自托管一体化软件开发服务，提供 Git 托管、代码评审、议题与看板、Wiki、包注册表以及可复用 GitHub Actions 的 CI/CD。
go-gitea/gitea.summary_en: A self-hosted all-in-one software development service written in Go, offering Git hosting, code review, issue tracking and kanban, wikis, a package registry, and CI/CD that can reuse GitHub Actions.

gogs/gogs.summary: 用 Go 编写的轻量自托管 Git 服务，以单个二进制文件跨平台部署，目标是最简单、稳定、可扩展的搭建方式。
gogs/gogs.summary_en: A lightweight self-hosted Git service written in Go, distributed as a single cross-platform binary and aimed at being the simplest, most stable, and extensible way to host Git.

medusajs/medusa.summary: 开源的电商平台与内置定制框架，以模块化构件构建自定义商业应用，涵盖商品、订单、支付、库存与管理后台，可自托管或使用云服务。
medusajs/medusa.summary_en: An open-source commerce platform with a built-in customization framework, using modular building blocks for custom commerce apps covering products, orders, payments, inventory, and an admin dashboard, self-hosted or on a managed cloud.

saleor/saleor.summary: 基于 GraphQL 的无头电商 API 平台，采用纯 API 架构与技术栈无关的设计，提供商品、订单、结账与仪表盘等能力。
saleor/saleor.summary_en: A GraphQL-native, API-only headless commerce platform designed to be technology-agnostic, providing products, orders, checkout, and a dashboard.

bagisto/bagisto.summary: 基于 Laravel 和 Vue.js 的开源电商与多商户市场平台，用于搭建单商户店铺、B2B 电商与多商户市场。
bagisto/bagisto.summary_en: An open-source eCommerce and multi-vendor marketplace platform built with Laravel and Vue.js for single-vendor stores, B2B commerce, and marketplaces.

pola-rs/polars.summary: 用 Rust 编写的 DataFrame 分析查询引擎，提供惰性与即时执行、查询优化、向量化多线程执行与超内存流式处理，有 Python、Rust、Node.js 与 R 接口。
pola-rs/polars.summary_en: An analytical query engine for DataFrames written in Rust, with lazy and eager execution, query optimization, vectorized multi-threaded execution, and larger-than-RAM streaming, exposed to Python, Rust, Node.js, and R.

apache/superset.summary: Apache 基金会的企业级商业智能 Web 应用，支持连接多种数据库、探索数据、构建图表与仪表盘，并提供 REST API 与扩展框架。
apache/superset.summary_en: An Apache enterprise business-intelligence web application for connecting to many databases, exploring data, and building charts and dashboards, with a REST API and extension framework.

metabase/metabase.summary: 开源商业智能与嵌入式分析工具，让团队成员无需写代码即可提问、可视化数据并构建仪表盘，也支持 SQL 与自托管部署。
metabase/metabase.summary_en: An open-source business-intelligence and embedded-analytics tool that lets people ask questions, visualize data, and build dashboards without writing code, with SQL support and self-hosting.

getredash/redash.summary: 面向团队的数据查询与可视化平台，可连接多种数据源，用 SQL 在浏览器中查询、制作图表与仪表盘并分享。
getredash/redash.summary_en: A data querying and visualization platform for teams that connects to many data sources and lets users query with SQL in the browser, build charts and dashboards, and share them.

dataease/dataease.summary: 开源 BI 工具，通过拖拽制作图表与仪表盘，支持 OLTP、OLAP 数据库、数据仓库、文件与 API 等多种数据源，并支持嵌入与分享。
dataease/dataease.summary_en: An open-source BI tool for building charts and dashboards by drag and drop, supporting OLTP and OLAP databases, data warehouses, files, and API sources, with embedding and sharing.

microsoft/vscode.summary: 微软主导的开源代码编辑器 VS Code 的开发仓库（Code - OSS），提供扩展体系、调试、Git 集成与语言服务协议，并公开路线图与迭代计划。
microsoft/vscode.summary_en: The development repository of Microsoft's open-source VS Code editor (Code - OSS), with an extension ecosystem, debugging, Git integration, and language-server support, and a public roadmap and iteration plans.

vim/vim.summary: Vim 官方仓库，Unix 经典编辑器 Vi 的增强版，提供多级撤销、语法高亮、命令历史、补全、脚本语言等功能。
vim/vim.summary_en: The official Vim repository, an improved version of the classic Unix editor Vi with multi-level undo, syntax highlighting, command history, completion, and a scripting language.

neovim/neovim.summary: Vim 的重构分支，目标是更易维护、更易扩展：提供异步任务与 RPC API、内置 LSP 与 Lua 支持，可被各语言和外部 GUI 驱动。
neovim/neovim.summary_en: A refactored fork of Vim aimed at easier maintenance and extensibility, with an asynchronous job and RPC API, built-in LSP and Lua support, and the ability to be driven from many languages and external GUIs.

zed-industries/zed.summary: 由 Atom 与 Tree-sitter 的创作者开发的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，用 Rust 编写，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。
zed-industries/zed.summary_en: A high-performance, multiplayer code editor written in Rust by the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter, available on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

helix-editor/helix.summary: 受 Kakoune 与 Neovim 启发、用 Rust 编写的模态文本编辑器，提供多光标选择、内置语言服务器支持和基于 Tree-sitter 的语法高亮。
helix-editor/helix.summary_en: A modal text editor written in Rust and inspired by Kakoune and Neovim, with multiple selections, built-in language server support, and Tree-sitter-based syntax highlighting.

coder/code-server.summary: 在任意机器上运行 VS Code 并通过浏览器访问，把编译、测试等重任务放到服务器上，在多种设备上获得一致的开发环境。
coder/code-server.summary_en: Runs VS Code on any machine and serves it in the browser, moving heavy work such as builds and tests to a server and giving a consistent development environment across devices.

lapce/lapce.summary: 用纯 Rust 编写的代码编辑器，界面基于 Floem，采用 wgpu 渲染，内置 LSP、模态编辑、插件与远程开发支持。
lapce/lapce.summary_en: A code editor written in pure Rust with a Floem UI and wgpu rendering, featuring built-in LSP, modal editing, plugins, and remote development.

git/git.summary: 分布式版本控制系统 Git 的源码镜像，提供高层操作与对内部机制的完整访问，最初由 Linus Torvalds 编写，补丁通过邮件列表提交。
git/git.summary_en: The source mirror of Git, the distributed version control system that offers both high-level operations and full access to internals; it was originally written by Linus Torvalds and takes patches through a mailing list.

curl/curl.summary: 用 URL 语法传输数据的命令行工具与 libcurl 库，支持 HTTP(S)、FTP、SFTP、SMTP、IMAP、MQTT、WebSocket 等数十种协议。
curl/curl.summary_en: A command-line tool and library (libcurl) for transferring data with URL syntax, supporting dozens of protocols including HTTP(S), FTP, SFTP, SMTP, IMAP, MQTT, and WebSocket.

junegunn/fzf.summary: 通用命令行模糊查找器与交互式终端工具包，可用来选择文件、浏览命令历史、预览数据，并与 Shell 深度集成，以单个二进制发布。
junegunn/fzf.summary_en: A general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder and interactive terminal toolkit for selecting files, browsing command history, and previewing data, with deep shell integration, distributed as a single binary.

BurntSushi/ripgrep.summary: 按行搜索的命令行工具，递归搜索目录中的正则匹配，默认遵守 gitignore 并跳过隐藏与二进制文件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
BurntSushi/ripgrep.summary_en: A line-oriented command-line search tool that recursively searches directories for a regex pattern, respecting gitignore rules and skipping hidden and binary files by default, on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

jqlang/jq.summary: 轻量灵活的命令行 JSON 处理器，类似 sed、awk 之于文本，用于切片、过滤、映射和转换结构化数据，用 C 编写且无运行时依赖。
jqlang/jq.summary_en: A lightweight command-line JSON processor, comparable to sed and awk for text, for slicing, filtering, mapping, and transforming structured data, written in portable C with no runtime dependencies.

sharkdp/fd.summary: find 的简单、快速、易用的替代品，默认支持正则与 glob、并行遍历目录、彩色输出并遵守 gitignore。
sharkdp/fd.summary_en: A simple, fast, and user-friendly alternative to find, with regex and glob patterns by default, parallelized directory traversal, colored output, and gitignore awareness.

sharkdp/bat.summary: 带语法高亮与 Git 集成的 cat 替代品，支持多种编程与标记语言、自动分页并可显示不可见字符。
sharkdp/bat.summary_en: A cat clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration that supports many programming and markup languages, automatic paging, and display of non-printable characters.

sharkdp/hyperfine.summary: 命令行基准测试工具，可对任意 Shell 命令多次运行做统计分析，支持预热、清缓存、异常值检测并导出 CSV 与 JSON 等格式。
sharkdp/hyperfine.summary_en: A command-line benchmarking tool that runs arbitrary shell commands repeatedly with statistical analysis, warmup runs, cache clearing, outlier detection, and export to formats such as CSV and JSON.

ajeetdsouza/zoxide.summary: 更智能的 cd 命令，记住常用目录并按访问频率与最近使用排序，几个按键即可跳转，支持主流 Shell。
ajeetdsouza/zoxide.summary_en: A smarter cd command that remembers the directories you use, ranks them by frequency and recency, and lets you jump to them in a few keystrokes, supporting all major shells.

tmux/tmux.summary: 终端复用器，可在一个屏幕中创建、访问和控制多个终端，会话可脱离后台运行并在之后重新连接。
tmux/tmux.summary_en: A terminal multiplexer that creates, accesses, and controls multiple terminals from a single screen, with sessions that can be detached, kept running in the background, and reattached later.

zellij-org/zellij.summary: 面向开发者与运维人员的终端工作区（终端复用器），强调开箱即用的体验，提供布局、插件与 WebAssembly 扩展。
zellij-org/zellij.summary_en: A terminal workspace (multiplexer) for developers and ops people that emphasizes a good out-of-the-box experience, with layouts, plugins, and WebAssembly extensions.

ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh.summary: 社区驱动的 zsh 配置管理框架，附带 300 多个可选插件（git、docker、node、python 等）、140 多个主题和自动更新工具。
ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh.summary_en: A community-driven framework for managing zsh configuration, with more than 300 optional plugins (git, docker, node, python, and more), more than 140 themes, and an auto-update tool.

starship/starship.summary: 适用于任意 Shell 的极简、快速、可高度定制的命令提示符，跨平台并按上下文显示 Git、语言版本、云环境等信息。
starship/starship.summary_en: A minimal, fast, and highly customizable prompt for any shell that works across operating systems and shows context such as Git status, language versions, and cloud environments.

jesseduffield/lazygit.summary: 用于 Git 命令的简洁终端界面，在终端里完成暂存、提交、分支、变基与冲突处理等常见操作。
jesseduffield/lazygit.summary_en: A simple terminal UI for Git commands, handling staging, committing, branching, rebasing, and conflict resolution from the terminal.

gitui-org/gitui.summary: 用 Rust 编写的快速 Git 终端界面，提供暂存、提交、分支、日志与差异查看，强调低内存占用与响应速度。
gitui-org/gitui.summary_en: A fast terminal UI for Git written in Rust, offering staging, committing, branching, log and diff views, with an emphasis on low memory use and responsiveness.

jj-vcs/jj.summary: Jujutsu：与 Git 兼容、既简单又强大的版本控制系统，以 Git 仓库为存储后端，提供自动重写提交、一等公民冲突与操作日志等特性。
jj-vcs/jj.summary_en: Jujutsu, a Git-compatible version control system that is both simple and powerful, using Git repositories as its storage backend with features such as automatic rebasing of commits, first-class conflicts, and an operation log.

dandavison/delta.summary: 为 git、diff、grep 与 blame 输出提供语法高亮的分页器，支持并排显示、行内词级差异高亮和导航。
dandavison/delta.summary_en: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, and blame output, with side-by-side view, word-level inline diff highlighting, and navigation between sections.

Wilfred/difftastic.summary: 基于语法的结构化 diff 工具，理解代码结构而非按行比较，重新格式化代码时只显示真正的语义变化。
Wilfred/difftastic.summary_en: A structural diff tool that compares files by syntax rather than by line, so reformatted code shows only the real changes.

casey/just.summary: 保存并运行项目命令的命令运行器，用类 make 语法在 justfile 中定义任务（recipes），并支持参数、跨平台和 Shell 集成。
casey/just.summary_en: A command runner for saving and running project-specific commands, defined as recipes in a justfile with make-inspired syntax, with arguments, cross-platform support, and shell integration.

nushell/nushell.summary: 新型 Shell，把管道中的数据当作结构化表格处理，支持 JSON、CSV 等格式的读取、过滤与转换，并提供插件与内置脚本语言。
nushell/nushell.summary_en: A new type of shell that treats pipeline data as structured tables, reading, filtering, and transforming formats such as JSON and CSV, with plugins and a built-in scripting language.

fish-shell/fish-shell.summary: 友好的命令行 Shell，开箱即用地提供语法高亮、输入时自动建议和补全，适用于 macOS、Linux 等系统。
fish-shell/fish-shell.summary_en: A smart and user-friendly command-line shell offering syntax highlighting, autosuggestions as you type, and tab completions with no configuration, for macOS, Linux, and similar systems.

atuinsh/atuin.summary: 用 SQLite 数据库取代 Shell 历史，额外记录退出码、耗时与目录等上下文，提供搜索界面和可选的端到端加密跨机器同步。
atuinsh/atuin.summary_en: Replaces shell history with a SQLite database that records context such as exit code, duration, and directory, with a search UI and optional end-to-end encrypted sync across machines.

koalaman/shellcheck.summary: 针对 bash / sh 脚本的静态分析工具，指出常见语法问题、语义陷阱与边界情况，并给出修复建议。
koalaman/shellcheck.summary_en: A static analysis tool for bash and sh scripts that points out common syntax problems, semantic pitfalls, and corner cases, with suggestions for fixing them.

wg/wrk.summary: 现代 HTTP 压测工具，多线程加事件通知机制，可在单台多核机器上产生大量负载，并支持用 LuaJIT 脚本生成请求与自定义报告。
wg/wrk.summary_en: A modern HTTP benchmarking tool that combines a multithreaded design with scalable event notification to generate heavy load from one multi-core machine, with LuaJIT scripting for request generation and custom reports.

alacritty/alacritty.summary: 跨平台、基于 OpenGL 的快速终端模拟器，默认配置合理并支持大量配置项，通过与其他程序集成而不重复实现其功能。
alacritty/alacritty.summary_en: A fast, cross-platform, OpenGL-based terminal emulator with sensible defaults and extensive configuration, integrating with other programs rather than reimplementing their features.

wezterm/wezterm.summary: 用 Rust 编写的 GPU 加速跨平台终端模拟器与复用器，支持标签、分屏、Lua 配置和内置多路复用。
wezterm/wezterm.summary_en: A GPU-accelerated cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer written in Rust, with tabs, splits, Lua configuration, and built-in multiplexing.

ghostty-org/ghostty.summary: 用 Zig 编写、使用平台原生界面与 GPU 加速的快速跨平台终端模拟器，并提供可嵌入的核心库 libghostty。
ghostty-org/ghostty.summary_en: A fast, cross-platform terminal emulator written in Zig with platform-native UI and GPU acceleration, plus an embeddable core library called libghostty.

kovidgoyal/kitty.summary: 跨平台、基于 GPU 的快速终端模拟器，功能丰富，支持图像显示、分屏布局、脚本化扩展（kittens）与远程控制。
kovidgoyal/kitty.summary_en: A fast, feature-rich, cross-platform GPU-based terminal emulator with image display, split layouts, scriptable extensions called kittens, and remote control.

Eugeny/tabby.summary: 高度可配置的现代终端应用，提供标签、分屏、SSH 与串口连接、插件系统，基于 Electron 并支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
Eugeny/tabby.summary_en: A highly configurable modern terminal application with tabs, split panes, SSH and serial connections, and a plugin system, built on Electron for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

microsoft/terminal.summary: Windows Terminal 与 Windows 控制台宿主的源码仓库，支持多标签、分屏、GPU 加速文本渲染，可运行命令提示符、PowerShell 与 WSL。
microsoft/terminal.summary_en: The source repository of Windows Terminal and the Windows console host, with multiple tabs and panes and GPU-accelerated text rendering, running Command Prompt, PowerShell, and WSL.

PowerShell/PowerShell.summary: 跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）的自动化与配置工具，包含命令行 Shell、脚本语言与 cmdlet 处理框架，擅长处理 JSON、CSV、REST API 等结构化数据。
PowerShell/PowerShell.summary_en: A cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) automation and configuration tool with a command-line shell, a scripting language, and a cmdlet framework, well suited to structured data such as JSON, CSV, and REST APIs.

eza-community/eza.summary: ls 的现代替代品，用颜色区分文件类型与元数据，识别符号链接、扩展属性与 Git 状态，以单个小型二进制发布。
eza-community/eza.summary_en: A modern replacement for ls that uses color to distinguish file types and metadata and understands symlinks, extended attributes, and Git status, shipped as a single small binary.

spf13/cobra.summary: 用于构建现代 Go 命令行应用的库，提供子命令、标志解析、自动帮助与补全生成，被 Kubernetes、Hugo、GitHub CLI 等项目采用。
spf13/cobra.summary_en: A library for building modern Go command-line applications with subcommands, flag parsing, and automatic help and completion generation, used by Kubernetes, Hugo, GitHub CLI, and many others.

charmbracelet/bubbletea.summary: 基于 Elm 架构的 Go 终端应用框架，适用于内嵌或全屏的 TUI，提供高性能渲染、颜色降级与键鼠事件处理。
charmbracelet/bubbletea.summary_en: A Go framework for terminal apps based on the Elm Architecture, suited to inline or full-window TUIs, with a high-performance renderer, color downsampling, and keyboard and mouse handling.

ratatui/ratatui.summary: 用于构建终端用户界面（TUI）的 Rust 库，提供布局、组件与即时模式渲染，并有模板与大量示例应用。
ratatui/ratatui.summary_en: A Rust crate for building terminal user interfaces, with layouts, widgets, and immediate-mode rendering, plus templates and many example apps.

vadimdemedes/ink.summary: 面向命令行应用的 React 渲染器，用组件构建并测试 CLI 输出，借助 Yoga 在终端中实现 Flexbox 布局。
vadimdemedes/ink.summary_en: A React renderer for command-line apps that builds and tests CLI output with components, using Yoga to bring Flexbox layout to the terminal.

Textualize/textual.summary: 用简单的 Python API 构建复杂界面的应用框架，同一套代码既可在终端也可在浏览器中运行，提供组件、样式与测试工具。
Textualize/textual.summary_en: An application framework that builds sophisticated user interfaces with a simple Python API, running the same app in the terminal or a web browser, with widgets, styling, and testing tools.

Textualize/rich.summary: 用于在终端中输出富文本与美观格式的 Python 库，可渲染彩色文本、表格、进度条、Markdown、语法高亮代码与回溯信息。
Textualize/rich.summary_en: A Python library for rich text and formatting in the terminal that renders color, tables, progress bars, Markdown, syntax-highlighted code, and tracebacks.

chalk/chalk.summary: Node.js 终端字符串样式库，提供可嵌套的样式 API，支持 256 色与真彩色并自动检测颜色支持，无依赖。
chalk/chalk.summary_en: A terminal string styling library for Node.js with a nestable style API, 256-color and truecolor support, automatic color-support detection, and no dependencies.

google/python-fire.summary: 可从任意 Python 对象（函数、类、模块、字典等）自动生成命令行接口的库，便于调试、探索代码与在 Bash 与 Python 间切换。
google/python-fire.summary_en: A library that automatically generates command-line interfaces from any Python object, such as a function, class, module, or dictionary, useful for debugging, exploring code, and moving between Bash and Python.

tqdm/tqdm.summary: 快速、可扩展的 Python 与命令行进度条，只需包装任意可迭代对象即可显示进度、速度与剩余时间，并支持 Jupyter 与管道。
tqdm/tqdm.summary_en: A fast, extensible progress bar for Python and the command line: wrap any iterable to show progress, speed, and estimated time remaining, with support for Jupyter and pipes.

nlohmann/json.summary: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 库，把 JSON 当作一等数据类型，提供类 STL 的访问、序列化与反序列化、JSON Pointer 与 Patch，并支持 BSON、CBOR 等二进制格式。
nlohmann/json.summary_en: A JSON library for modern C++ that treats JSON as a first-class data type, with STL-like access, serialization, JSON Pointer and Patch, and binary formats such as BSON and CBOR.

fmtlib/fmt.summary: C++ 格式化库，是 C stdio 与 iostreams 的快速安全替代，实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print。
fmtlib/fmt.summary_en: A C++ formatting library that is a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams and the basis of C++20 std::format and C++23 std::print.

gabime/spdlog.summary: 快速的 C++ 日志库，可作为仅头文件或编译库使用，支持多种输出目标、异步日志与自定义格式，覆盖主流平台。
gabime/spdlog.summary_en: A fast C++ logging library usable as header-only or compiled, with multiple sinks, asynchronous logging, and custom formatting on all major platforms.

google/googletest.summary: Google 的 C++ 测试与 Mock 框架（GoogleTest 与 GoogleMock），提供断言、测试夹具、参数化测试与死亡测试。
google/googletest.summary_en: Google's C++ testing and mocking framework (GoogleTest and GoogleMock), with assertions, fixtures, parameterized tests, and death tests.

facebook/folly.summary: Meta（Facebook）开源的 C++20 组件库，包含大量在 Meta 内部广泛使用的核心组件，也是其他 C++ 开源项目共享代码的基础。
facebook/folly.summary_en: Meta's open-source library of C++20 components, containing many core pieces used throughout Meta and serving as the shared foundation of its other C++ projects.

simdjson/simdjson.summary: 利用 SIMD 指令每秒解析数 GB JSON 的 C++ 库，宣称比常用生产级解析器快 4 倍以上，被 Node.js、ClickHouse 等项目使用。
simdjson/simdjson.summary_en: A C++ library that uses SIMD instructions to parse gigabytes of JSON per second, claiming to be over 4x faster than common production parsers and used by projects such as Node.js and ClickHouse.

libuv/libuv.summary: 以异步 I/O 为核心的跨平台支持库，最初为 Node.js 开发，提供事件循环、异步 TCP/UDP、DNS、文件系统操作、进程与线程池等。
libuv/libuv.summary_en: A cross-platform support library focused on asynchronous I/O, originally developed for Node.js, providing an event loop, asynchronous TCP and UDP, DNS, filesystem operations, processes, and a thread pool.

microsoft/vcpkg.summary: 微软与社区维护的免费开源 C/C++ 包管理器，提供大量开源库，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，并可配合 CMake 与清单文件管理依赖。
microsoft/vcpkg.summary_en: A free, open-source C/C++ package manager maintained by Microsoft and the community, offering a large collection of libraries on Windows, macOS, and Linux and integrating with CMake and manifest files.

llvm/llvm-project.summary: LLVM 项目：模块化、可复用的编译器与工具链技术集合，核心包括中间表示、优化器与代码生成，并含 Clang、LLDB、libc++ 等子项目。
llvm/llvm-project.summary_en: The LLVM Project, a collection of modular, reusable compiler and toolchain technologies whose core covers the intermediate representation, optimizers, and code generation, alongside subprojects such as Clang, LLDB, and libc++.

vlang/v.summary: V 编程语言：简单、快速、安全的编译型语言，编译速度快、零依赖，支持 C 到 V 的自动翻译。
vlang/v.summary_en: The V programming language, a simple, fast, and safe compiled language with fast compilation, zero library dependencies, and automatic C-to-V translation.

carbon-language/carbon-lang.summary: Carbon 语言的主仓库：作为 C++ 实验性继任者的设计文档、实现与工具，目标是性能与 C++ 相当并能与现有 C++ 代码互操作，官方注明尚不可用于生产。
carbon-language/carbon-lang.summary_en: The main repository of the Carbon language, an experimental successor to C++ with design documents, implementation, and tools, aiming to match C++ performance and interoperate with existing C++ code; the project says it is not ready for use.

RustPython/RustPython.summary: 用 Rust 编写的 Python 3 解释器，可嵌入 Rust 程序并编译到 WebAssembly，提供在线演示。
RustPython/RustPython.summary_en: A Python 3 interpreter written in Rust that can be embedded in Rust programs and compiled to WebAssembly, with an online demo.

tree-sitter/tree-sitter.summary: 解析器生成工具与增量解析库，为源文件构建具体语法树并随编辑高效更新，支持多种语言语法，被编辑器与代码分析工具广泛使用。
tree-sitter/tree-sitter.summary_en: A parser generator and incremental parsing library that builds a concrete syntax tree for a source file and updates it efficiently as the file is edited, with grammars for many languages, widely used in editors and code-analysis tools.

codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x.summary: 通过从零重新实现常用技术来学习编程的分步教程合集，按主题收录 3D 渲染器、数据库、Docker、Git、Shell、前端框架、编程语言、操作系统、区块链等数十类「自己动手写」的指南。
codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x.summary_en: A compilation of step-by-step guides for learning programming by re-creating popular technologies from scratch, organized by topic across dozens of categories such as 3D renderers, databases, Docker, Git, shells, front-end frameworks, programming languages, operating systems, and blockchains.

t8y2/dbx.summary: 轻量级跨平台数据库客户端，约 25 MB，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、DuckDB、SQL Server 等 100 多种数据库，提供桌面端、Docker 与命令行版本，并内置 AI 助手和 MCP Server。
t8y2/dbx.summary_en: A lightweight cross-platform database client of about 25 MB supporting more than 100 databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, and SQL Server, available as a desktop app, Docker image, and CLI, with a built-in AI assistant and MCP server.

github/gitignore.summary: GitHub 官方维护的 .gitignore 模板集合，用于填充 GitHub 网页上创建仓库和文件时的 .gitignore 模板选择器，覆盖各类语言、框架与编辑器。
github/gitignore.summary_en: GitHub's collection of .gitignore file templates, used to populate the .gitignore template chooser when creating repositories and files on GitHub.com, covering many languages, frameworks, and editors.

nvbn/thefuck.summary: 自动纠正上一条错误控制台命令的命令行工具，可识别拼写错误、权限不足等常见问题并给出修正后的命令，还提供实验性的即时模式。
nvbn/thefuck.summary_en: A command-line tool that corrects errors in your previous console command, recognizing typos, missing permissions, and other common mistakes and suggesting the fixed command, with an experimental instant mode.

warpdotdev/warp.summary: 从终端发展而来的智能开发环境，内置编码 Agent，也可接入 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等命令行 Agent，支持 macOS、Linux 与 Windows。
warpdotdev/warp.summary_en: An agentic development environment born out of the terminal, with a built-in coding agent that can also host CLI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

romkatv/powerlevel10k.summary: 强调速度、灵活性与开箱即用体验的 Zsh 主题，提供交互式配置向导和丰富的提示符信息；README 说明项目目前只提供极有限的支持。
romkatv/powerlevel10k.summary_en: A Zsh theme that emphasizes speed, flexibility, and an out-of-the-box experience, with an interactive configuration wizard and rich prompt segments; the README says the project now has very limited support.

GitSquared/edex-ui.summary: 外观和体验像科幻电影界面的全屏跨平台终端模拟器与系统监视器，灵感来自《创：战纪》，兼顾实际可用性；项目已于 2021 年归档。
GitSquared/edex-ui.summary_en: A fullscreen cross-platform terminal emulator and system monitor styled after a sci-fi computer interface, inspired by TRON: Legacy yet meant to be usable in real life; the project was archived in 2021.

vercel/hyper.summary: 基于开放 Web 标准（HTML、CSS、JavaScript）构建的终端，重点是速度、稳定性和面向扩展作者的 API。
vercel/hyper.summary_en: A terminal built on open web standards (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript), focused on speed, stability, and an API for extension authors.

sxyazi/yazi.summary: 用 Rust 编写、基于非阻塞异步 I/O 的终端文件管理器，所有 I/O 操作异步执行，CPU 任务分散到多线程，注重速度与可定制性。
sxyazi/yazi.summary_en: A terminal file manager written in Rust on non-blocking async I/O, running all I/O asynchronously and spreading CPU work across threads, with an emphasis on speed and customization.

zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions.summary: 为 zsh 提供类似 fish 的命令自动建议，根据历史记录和补全在输入时以灰色显示建议，按方向键即可接受。
zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions.summary_en: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh that show a muted-gray completion as you type based on history and completions, accepted with the right-arrow key.

zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting.summary: 为 zsh 提供类似 fish 的命令语法高亮，在输入时高亮命令，便于在执行前发现拼写和语法错误。
zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting.summary_en: Fish-like syntax highlighting for zsh that highlights commands as they are typed, helping catch typos and syntax errors before running them.

aristocratos/btop.summary: 命令行资源监视器，实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络与进程信息，界面美观、支持主题，可在 Linux、macOS 与 BSD 上运行。
aristocratos/btop.summary_en: A command-line resource monitor showing CPU, memory, disk, network, and process information in real time, with a polished interface and themes, on Linux, macOS, and the BSDs.

nicolargo/glances.summary: 用 Python 编写的跨平台系统监控工具，是 top / htop 的替代品，可在终端或 Web 界面中查看 CPU、内存、磁盘与网络等系统信息。
nicolargo/glances.summary_en: A cross-platform system monitoring tool written in Python, an alternative to top and htop, showing CPU, memory, disk, and network information in the terminal or a web UI.

kingToolbox/WindTerm.summary: 面向运维的跨平台 SSH / Telnet / 串口 / Shell / SFTP 终端客户端，支持商业与非商业免费使用，源码以 Apache-2.0 发布（第三方目录除外）。
kingToolbox/WindTerm.summary_en: A cross-platform SSH, Telnet, serial, shell, and SFTP terminal client for DevOps, free for commercial and non-commercial use, with released source under Apache-2.0 apart from the third-party directory.

mathiasbynens/dotfiles.summary: Mathias 的个人 dotfiles，包含 bash 配置与 macOS 合理默认设置（~/.macos），通过引导脚本安装，作者提醒使用前先 fork 并审阅代码。
mathiasbynens/dotfiles.summary_en: Mathias's personal dotfiles, including bash configuration and sensible macOS defaults (~/.macos), installed with a bootstrap script; the author advises forking and reviewing the code before use.

charmbracelet/glow.summary: 在终端里渲染 Markdown 的阅读器，可发现并浏览本地或 Git 仓库中的 Markdown 文件，直接在命令行阅读文档。
charmbracelet/glow.summary_en: A terminal-based Markdown reader that discovers and browses Markdown files in local folders or a Git repository so you can read documentation on the command line.

charmbracelet/gum.summary: 为 Shell 脚本提供现成的交互组件（选择、输入、确认、过滤、样式化等），基于 Bubbles 与 Lip Gloss，无需编写 Go 代码即可让脚本更好看易用。
charmbracelet/gum.summary_en: A tool that gives shell scripts ready-made interactive components such as choose, input, confirm, filter, and styling, built on Bubbles and Lip Gloss, with no Go code needed.

ggreer/the_silver_searcher.summary: 类似 ack 但更快的代码搜索工具（ag），自动忽略 .gitignore 与 .hgignore 中的文件，命令更短，适合在大型代码库中检索。
ggreer/the_silver_searcher.summary_en: A code-searching tool (ag) similar to ack but faster, ignoring patterns from .gitignore and .hgignore, with a shorter command, suited to searching large codebases.

cmderdev/cmder.summary: 基于 ConEmu 的 Windows 便携式控制台模拟器套件，附带 Monokai 配色、clink 补全与自定义提示符，无需外部依赖，可放在 U 盘或云盘中携带。
cmderdev/cmder.summary_en: A portable console emulator package for Windows based on ConEmu, with a Monokai color scheme, clink completions, and a custom prompt, self-contained so it can be carried on a USB stick or cloud storage.

nvie/gitflow.summary: 为 Vincent Driessen 的 Git 分支模型提供高层仓库操作的 Git 扩展；README 说明仓库已不再维护，已迁移到 git-flow-next。
nvie/gitflow.summary_en: Git extensions that provide high-level repository operations for Vincent Driessen's branching model; the README says the repository is no longer maintained and has moved to git-flow-next.

mislav/hub.summary: 包装 git 的命令行工具，为 git 增加与 GitHub 交互的命令，例如克隆仓库、创建拉取请求与查看议题；官方更推荐使用 GitHub CLI。
mislav/hub.summary_en: A command-line tool that wraps git to add GitHub-oriented commands such as cloning repositories, creating pull requests, and viewing issues; the README points to the official GitHub CLI as an alternative.

Swordfish90/cool-retro-term.summary: 模拟老式阴极射线管显示器外观的终端模拟器，注重视觉效果与可定制性，基于 Qt 6 的 QML 实现，支持 Linux 与 macOS。
Swordfish90/cool-retro-term.summary_en: A terminal emulator that mimics the look and feel of old cathode-ray tube screens, designed to be eye candy yet customizable, built with QML on Qt 6 for Linux and macOS.

gpakosz/.tmux.summary: 自包含、美观且实用的 tmux 配置（Oh my tmux!），提供状态栏、鼠标与剪贴板集成等增强，可在 Linux、macOS、BSD 上使用。
gpakosz/.tmux.summary_en: A self-contained, pretty, and versatile tmux configuration (Oh my tmux!) with an improved status bar and mouse and clipboard integration, for Linux, macOS, and the BSDs.

withfig/autocomplete.summary: 为现有终端与 Shell 提供 IDE 风格补全的项目，为 git、npm、docker、aws 等数百个命令行工具补全子命令、选项与参数；该项目后来演变为 Amazon Q Developer CLI。
withfig/autocomplete.summary_en: IDE-style autocomplete for your existing terminal and shell, completing subcommands, options, and arguments for hundreds of CLIs such as git, npm, docker, and aws; the project later became Amazon Q Developer CLI.

fastfetch-cli/fastfetch.summary: 类似 neofetch 的系统信息展示工具，以 C 为主编写，强调性能与可定制性，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 与多种 BSD。
fastfetch-cli/fastfetch.summary_en: A neofetch-like tool for displaying system information, written mainly in C with an emphasis on performance and customizability, supporting Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and several BSDs.

ogham/exa.summary: ls 的现代替代品，用颜色区分文件类型与元数据并识别 Git 状态；README 说明项目已无人维护，建议改用其分支 eza。
ogham/exa.summary_en: A modern replacement for ls that colors file types and metadata and understands Git status; the README says it is unmaintained and recommends the fork eza.

uutils/coreutils.summary: 用 Rust 对 GNU coreutils 的跨平台重新实现，提供预编译二进制、手册页与 Shell 补全，所有程序都已实现，但部分选项可能缺失或行为不同。
uutils/coreutils.summary_en: A cross-platform reimplementation of the GNU coreutils in Rust, with prebuilt binaries, man pages, and shell completions; all programs are implemented, though some options may be missing or behave differently.

dylanaraps/neofetch.summary: 用 bash 编写的命令行系统信息工具，在操作系统标志旁展示系统与硬件信息，常用于系统截图；仓库已归档。
dylanaraps/neofetch.summary_en: A command-line system information tool written in bash that displays OS, software, and hardware details beside the system logo, commonly used for system screenshots; the repository is archived.

AlDanial/cloc.summary: 统计多种编程语言源码中空行、注释行与代码行数的命令行工具，用 Perl 编写，提供 Windows 可执行文件与 Docker 镜像。
AlDanial/cloc.summary_en: A command-line tool that counts blank, comment, and physical lines of source code across many programming languages, written in Perl and offered as a Windows executable and a Docker image.

JanDeDobbeleer/oh-my-posh.summary: 跨平台、低延迟且高度可定制的 Shell 提示符渲染器，起源于 PowerShell 的 oh-my-posh2，用 Go 重写，支持主题与多种 Shell。
JanDeDobbeleer/oh-my-posh.summary_en: A cross-platform, low-latency, highly customizable shell prompt renderer that grew out of oh-my-posh2 for PowerShell and was rewritten in Go, with themes and support for many shells.

yorukot/superfile.summary: 美观现代的终端文件管理器，提供常见文件操作、插件、主题与快捷键，支持 macOS、Linux 与 Windows。
yorukot/superfile.summary_en: A pretty, modern terminal file manager with common file operations, plugins, themes, and hotkeys, for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

pranshuparmar/witr.summary: 回答「为什么这个在运行」的命令行与终端界面工具，可把进程、端口、容器或文件追溯到启动它们的完整调用链，支持机器可读的 JSON 输出。
pranshuparmar/witr.summary_en: A CLI and TUI tool that answers "why is this running?", tracing a process, port, container, or file back to the chain that started it, with machine-readable JSON output.

atom/atom.summary: GitHub 出品、基于 Electron 的可定制文本编辑器，主打可深度定制又不失易用；Atom 及其下所有仓库已于 2022 年 12 月归档。
atom/atom.summary_en: A hackable text editor built on Electron that aims to be deeply customizable yet approachable; Atom and all repositories under it were archived in December 2022.

adobe/brackets.summary: 用 HTML、CSS 与 JavaScript 构建的面向 Web 开发的现代开源代码编辑器，提供实时预览和内联编辑；Adobe 已于 2021 年 9 月停止支持。
adobe/brackets.summary_en: A modern open-source code editor for web development, built in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with live preview and inline editing; Adobe ended support in September 2021.

VSCodium/vscodium.summary: 自动把微软 vscode 仓库构建成不含微软品牌、遥测和专有许可的自由许可二进制文件的脚本仓库，并提供多种包管理器的安装方式。
VSCodium/vscodium.summary_en: A repository of scripts that automatically builds Microsoft's vscode repository into freely licensed binaries without Microsoft branding, telemetry, or proprietary licensing, installable through many package managers.

micro-editor/micro.summary: 现代易用的终端文本编辑器，是 nano 的继任者，以无依赖的单一静态二进制发布，适合在 SSH 会话中全职使用。
micro-editor/micro.summary_en: A modern, intuitive terminal text editor meant as a successor to nano, shipped as a single dependency-free static binary suited to full-time use over SSH.

notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus.summary: 免费的源码编辑器与记事本替代品，支持多种编程语言和自然语言，运行于 Windows，采用 GPL 许可，发布包带有 GPG 签名。
notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus.summary_en: A free source-code editor and Notepad replacement supporting several programming and natural languages, running on Windows under the GPL, with GPG-signed releases.

syl20bnr/spacemacs.summary: 社区驱动的 Emacs 发行版，融合 Vim 的模态编辑与 Emacs 的能力，按功能层组织配置，开箱即用并提供助记键位菜单。
syl20bnr/spacemacs.summary_en: A community-driven Emacs distribution that combines Vim-style modal editing with Emacs, organizes configuration into layers, and works out of the box with a mnemonic key-binding menu.

doomemacs/core.summary: 面向 Vim 用户的 Emacs 配置框架，强调速度与可自定义，内置模块化功能与文档，以「顽固的火星人黑客」自居。
doomemacs/core.summary_en: An Emacs configuration framework aimed at Vim users that emphasizes speed and customizability, with modular built-in features and documentation.

CodeEditApp/CodeEdit.summary: 完全为 macOS 编写的社区代码编辑器，功能包括语法高亮、代码补全、查找替换、终端、调试、Git 集成与扩展；README 说明仍在开发中，尚不建议用于生产。
CodeEditApp/CodeEdit.summary_en: A community-built code editor written entirely for macOS, with syntax highlighting, code completion, find and replace, a terminal, debugging, Git integration, and extensions; the README says it is still in development and not yet recommended for production.

junegunn/vim-plug.summary: 极简的 Vim 插件管理器，单文件无依赖，支持并行安装与更新、按需加载和浅克隆，兼容自 2006 年以来的所有 Vim 与 Neovim 版本。
junegunn/vim-plug.summary_en: A minimalist Vim plugin manager in a single dependency-free file, with parallel install and update, on-demand loading, and shallow clones, compatible with every Vim since 2006 and all Neovim versions.

VundleVim/Vundle.vim.summary: Vim 插件管理器，可在 .vimrc 中声明并配置插件，通过一次按键完成安装、更新、按名称搜索和清理未使用的插件。
VundleVim/Vundle.vim.summary_en: A Vim plugin manager that lets you declare and configure plugins in your .vimrc and install, update, search, and clean them up with a single keypress.

amix/vimrc.summary: 作者用了十多年的「终极」Vim 配置，提供精简的 basic 版本和带大量插件、配色方案与配置的 awesome 版本，可为单个用户或全局安装。
amix/vimrc.summary_en: The author's decade-long "ultimate" Vim configuration, offered as a small basic version and an awesome version with many plugins, color schemes, and settings, installable per user or system-wide.

nvim-lua/kickstart.nvim.summary: Neovim 配置的起点：单文件、注释完整、体量小；并非发行版，而是让你在此基础上搭建自己的配置，只面向最新的稳定版与 nightly 版。
nvim-lua/kickstart.nvim.summary_en: A starting point for your Neovim configuration: small, single-file, and fully documented; it is not a distribution but a base to build on, targeting only the latest stable and nightly Neovim.

NvChad/NvChad.summary: 用 Lua 编写的 Neovim 配置框架，提供美观的界面与极快的启动速度，大部分插件按需懒加载，并调校了 telescope、nvim-tree 等界面插件。
NvChad/NvChad.summary_en: A Neovim configuration framework written in Lua with a polished UI and very fast startup, lazy-loading most plugins on demand and tuning UI plugins such as telescope and nvim-tree.

LazyVim/LazyVim.summary: 基于 lazy.nvim 的 Neovim 配置，兼顾从零搭建的灵活性与预设发行版的便利，把 Neovim 变成完整 IDE，并便于自定义和扩展。
LazyVim/LazyVim.summary_en: A Neovim setup powered by lazy.nvim that offers both the flexibility of starting from scratch and the convenience of a pre-made distribution, turning Neovim into a full IDE that is easy to customize and extend.

ycm-core/YouCompleteMe.summary: 面向 Vim 的代码补全引擎，提供语义补全与诊断，通过语言服务器支持多种语言，推荐使用附带的 install.py 安装。
ycm-core/YouCompleteMe.summary_en: A code-completion engine for Vim providing semantic completion and diagnostics across many languages through language servers, installed with the supplied install.py.

neoclide/coc.nvim.summary: 面向 Vim 与 Neovim 的 IntelliSense 引擎，通过 Node.js 服务带来类似 VS Code 的补全、诊断、导航、重构与扩展支持，可托管语言服务器。
neoclide/coc.nvim.summary_en: An IntelliSense engine for Vim and Neovim that brings VS Code-like completion, diagnostics, navigation, refactoring, and extensions through a Node.js service, and can host language servers.

Homebrew/brew.summary: 面向 macOS 与 Linux 的包管理器 Homebrew，提供 brew bundle 等功能，由志愿者运营的非营利项目。
Homebrew/brew.summary_en: Homebrew, the package manager for macOS and Linux with features such as brew bundle, run by volunteers as a non-profit project.

Homebrew/homebrew-cask.summary: Homebrew Cask 的默认软件包仓库，把 Homebrew 的命令行工作流扩展到上游厂商发布的预编译软件，包括 GUI 应用、命令行工具与字体等。
Homebrew/homebrew-cask.summary_en: The default cask repository of Homebrew Cask, extending Homebrew's command-line workflow to prebuilt software distributed by upstream vendors, including GUI apps, CLI tools, and fonts.

microsoft/winget-cli.summary: Windows 程序包管理器 WinGet 的客户端，包含命令行、PowerShell 模块与 COM API，可从 Microsoft Store 和社区仓库两个默认源安装软件。
microsoft/winget-cli.summary_en: The client of WinGet, the Windows Package Manager, including a CLI, PowerShell modules, and a COM API, installing software from two default sources: the Microsoft Store and the WinGet community repository.

ScoopInstaller/Scoop.summary: Windows 上的命令行安装器，以最少的操作安装应用：不弹 UAC 提示、隐藏安装向导界面、不污染 PATH，并自动解析和安装依赖。
ScoopInstaller/Scoop.summary_en: A command-line installer for Windows that installs apps with minimal friction: no UAC prompts, hidden installer wizards, no PATH pollution, and automatic dependency resolution.

NixOS/nixpkgs.summary: 包含超过 14 万个软件包的 Nix 包集合，可用 Nix 包管理器安装，同时实现纯函数式 Linux 发行版 NixOS，附各类手册与社区渠道。
NixOS/nixpkgs.summary_en: A collection of over 140,000 software packages installable with the Nix package manager, which also implements NixOS, a purely functional Linux distribution, with manuals and community channels.

Devolutions/UniGetUI.summary: 面向 Windows 10 与 11 常用命令行包管理器的图形界面，也提供 macOS 与 Linux 版本，支持 WinGet、Scoop、Chocolatey、Homebrew、APT 等。
Devolutions/UniGetUI.summary_en: A graphical interface for the most common command-line package managers on Windows 10 and 11, with builds for macOS and Linux, supporting WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey, Homebrew, APT, and more.

apify/crawlee.summary: 面向 Node.js 的网页抓取与浏览器自动化库，用 JavaScript / TypeScript 构建可靠爬虫，可配合 Puppeteer、Playwright、Cheerio 与 JSDOM 使用，支持代理轮换与文件下载。
apify/crawlee.summary_en: A web scraping and browser automation library for Node.js for building reliable crawlers in JavaScript and TypeScript, working with Puppeteer, Playwright, Cheerio, and JSDOM, with proxy rotation and file downloads.

discordjs/discord.js.summary: 用于与 Discord API 交互的 Node.js 库，仓库包含多个独立发布的包，如核心库、创建机器人的脚手架 CLI 与消息代理等。
discordjs/discord.js.summary_en: A Node.js library for interacting with the Discord API; the repository holds several separately released packages such as the core library, a bot scaffolding CLI, and message brokers.

wechaty/wechaty.summary: 面向聊天机器人开发者的对话式 RPA SDK，为 WhatsApp、微信等多个消息平台提供统一接口，机器人代码只需写一次即可跨平台运行。
wechaty/wechaty.summary_en: A conversational RPA SDK for chatbot makers that provides one interface to messaging platforms such as WhatsApp and WeChat, so bot code is written once and runs on any supported platform.

wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js.summary: 通过 WhatsApp Web 浏览器应用连接的 Node.js WhatsApp 客户端库，借助 Puppeteer 调用其内部函数，提供接近网页版全部功能的 API。
wwebjs/whatsapp-web.js.summary_en: A Node.js WhatsApp client library that connects through the WhatsApp Web browser app, using Puppeteer to call its internal functions and offering an API for nearly all web-client features.

chenglou/pretext.summary: 纯 JavaScript / TypeScript 的多行文本测量与排版库，不依赖 DOM 测量以避免触发布局回流，支持多语言并可渲染到 DOM、Canvas 与 SVG。
chenglou/pretext.summary_en: A pure JavaScript and TypeScript library for multiline text measurement and layout that avoids DOM measurements to sidestep layout reflow, supports many languages, and renders to the DOM, Canvas, and SVG.

scrapy/scrapy.summary: 快速的高层 Python 网页抓取与爬虫框架，用于从网站提取结构化数据。
scrapy/scrapy.summary_en: A fast, high-level Python web crawling and scraping framework for extracting structured data from websites.

gocolly/colly.summary: Go 语言的优雅爬虫与抓取框架，提供简洁的接口来编写各类爬虫，用于数据挖掘、处理与归档，单核可达每秒上千次请求。
gocolly/colly.summary_en: An elegant scraping and crawling framework for Go that offers a clean interface for writing crawlers for data mining, processing, and archiving, reaching over a thousand requests per second on a single core.

python-telegram-bot/python-telegram-bot.summary: Telegram Bot API 的 Python 封装库，为构建 Telegram 机器人提供 Python 接口。
python-telegram-bot/python-telegram-bot.summary_en: A Python wrapper for the Telegram Bot API that provides a Python interface for building Telegram bots.

littlecodersh/ItChat.summary: 开源的微信个人号 Python 接口，三十行左右代码即可实现处理消息的微信机器人，也可用于命令行微信等场景。
littlecodersh/ItChat.summary_en: An open-source Python interface for personal WeChat accounts that lets you build a message-handling WeChat bot in about thirty lines of code, also usable for command-line WeChat.

fzaninotto/Faker.summary: 生成假数据的 PHP 库，可用于填充数据库、生成 XML 文档、压力测试或匿名化生产数据；仓库已归档。
fzaninotto/Faker.summary_en: A PHP library that generates fake data for bootstrapping databases, creating XML documents, stress testing, or anonymizing production data; the repository is archived.

ariya/phantomjs.summary: 可用 JavaScript 编写脚本的无头 WebKit 浏览器，用于无界面网页测试、页面自动化与截图；开发已暂停，最终稳定版为 2.1。
ariya/phantomjs.summary_en: A headless WebKit browser scriptable with JavaScript, used for headless web testing, page automation, and screen capture; development is suspended and 2.1 is the last stable release.

minimaxir/big-list-of-naughty-strings.summary: 一份在用作用户输入时极易引发问题的字符串清单，用于自动化和人工 QA 测试，可用来发现零宽字符、注入与编码等边界问题。
minimaxir/big-list-of-naughty-strings.summary_en: A list of strings with a high probability of causing problems as user input, for automated and manual QA testing to surface edge cases such as zero-width characters, injection, and encoding issues.

JuliaLang/julia.summary: Julia 编程语言的源码仓库：面向科学与技术计算的高层、高性能动态语言，附编译安装说明及文档、包与社区链接。
JuliaLang/julia.summary_en: The source repository of the Julia programming language, a high-level, high-performance dynamic language for technical computing, with build instructions and links to documentation, packages, and the community.

bendlang/bend.summary: Bend 编程语言：一门强调法则与证明的高性能语言，以机械验证确保 AI 生成的实现符合意图，并以在 CPU 上接近 C、在 GPU 上接近 CUDA 的速度为目标。
bendlang/bend.summary_en: The Bend programming language, a fast language built around laws and proofs so that an implementation can be mechanically verified against intent, aiming to approach C speed on CPUs and CUDA speed on GPUs.

nothings/stb.summary: stb 系列单头文件公共领域（或 MIT）C/C++ 库，包括图像加载与写入、缩放、字体光栅化和类型安全容器等；README 提醒安全问题的修复可能较慢。
nothings/stb.summary_en: The stb series of single-file public-domain (or MIT) C/C++ libraries, including image loading, writing, and resizing, font rasterization, and typesafe containers; the README warns that security fixes may take time.

facebook/zstd.summary: Zstandard：面向实时场景的快速无损压缩算法，压缩率达到 zlib 水平及以上，格式已在 RFC 8878 中稳定定义，仓库提供 C 参考实现与命令行工具。
facebook/zstd.summary_en: Zstandard, a fast lossless compression algorithm for real-time scenarios that reaches zlib-level and better ratios, with a stable format documented in RFC 8878; the repository holds the C reference implementation and a command-line tool.

openssl/openssl.summary: 通用 TLS 与密码学库，提供 TLS、DTLS 与 QUIC 协议实现和独立可用的密码学库，并包含符合 FIPS 标准的密码模块。
openssl/openssl.summary_en: A general-purpose TLS and cryptography library providing TLS, DTLS, and QUIC implementations and a stand-alone cryptographic library, including a FIPS-validated cryptographic module.

zxing/zxing.summary: Java 与 Android 的条码扫描与生成库（Zebra Crossing）；项目已进入维护模式，仅接受贡献的补丁。
zxing/zxing.summary_en: A barcode scanning and generation library for Java and Android (Zebra Crossing); the project is in maintenance mode and only accepts contributed patches.

firecracker-microvm/firecracker.summary: 为无服务器计算设计的安全、快速的微虚拟机（microVM）技术，用轻量虚拟机运行多租户的容器与函数工作负载，兼具硬件虚拟化的隔离与容器的速度。
firecracker-microvm/firecracker.summary_en: A virtualization technology purpose-built for serverless computing that runs multi-tenant container and function workloads in lightweight microVMs, combining hardware-virtualization isolation with container-like speed.

rust-lang/mdBook.summary: 用 Markdown 文件创建在线书籍的工具，类似 GitBook 但用 Rust 实现，用户指南本身即是成书效果的示范。
rust-lang/mdBook.summary_en: A utility that creates modern online books from Markdown files, similar to GitBook but implemented in Rust, with a user guide that doubles as a demo.

pedronauck/docz.summary: 用 MDX 为代码编写并发布交互式文档的工具，把 MDX 文件变成支持热重载、对 SEO 友好的生产级文档站，并可自定义外观；仓库已归档。
pedronauck/docz.summary_en: A tool for writing and publishing interactive documentation for code that turns MDX files into a live-reloading, SEO-friendly, production-ready docs site with customizable look and feel; the repository is archived.

GitbookIO/gitbook.summary: GitBook 用于渲染已发布内容的开源前端代码，GitBook 是面向团队的技术知识管理平台，仓库也说明了本地运行方式与贡献流程。
GitbookIO/gitbook.summary_en: The open-source frontend GitBook uses to render published content, a platform for managing technical knowledge for teams, with instructions for running it locally and contributing.

badges/shields.summary: Shields.io 服务的源码，为 GitHub README 等页面生成简洁一致的 SVG 与位图徽章，支持数十种持续集成、包仓库、覆盖率与社交网络等数据源。
badges/shields.summary_en: The source of the Shields.io service, which generates concise, consistent SVG and raster badges for GitHub READMEs and web pages, supporting dozens of CI services, package registries, coverage services, and social networks.

carbon-app/carbon.summary: 为源代码生成并分享精美图片的工具，可自定义外观，用于制作在社交媒体上分享的代码截图。
carbon-app/carbon.summary_en: A tool for creating and sharing beautiful images of source code, with customizable styling, for code screenshots shared on social media.

CorentinTh/it-tools.summary: 面向开发者与 IT 人员的在线工具集合，体验良好，可通过 Docker 自托管。
CorentinTh/it-tools.summary_en: A collection of handy online tools for developers and IT people with good UX, self-hostable with Docker.

DevToys-app/DevToys.summary: 面向开发者的瑞士军刀式桌面应用，2.0 版内置 30 个默认小工具，涵盖转换器、编码解码器、格式化器与生成器，并能根据剪贴板内容智能选择工具。
DevToys-app/DevToys.summary_en: A Swiss Army knife desktop app for developers, whose 2.0 release ships 30 default tools across converters, encoders and decoders, formatters, and generators, with smart detection that picks a tool for your clipboard content.

d2lang/d2.summary: 现代化的图表脚本语言，把文本转换为图表，提供多种主题、字体、布局引擎和导出格式，也可作为库使用并附在线 Playground。
d2lang/d2.summary_en: A modern diagram scripting language that turns text into diagrams, with themes, fonts, layout engines, and export formats, also usable as a library, with an online playground.

mingrammer/diagrams.summary: 用 Python 代码绘制云系统架构图的「图即代码」工具，支持 AWS、Azure、GCP、Kubernetes 等主要云厂商、本地节点与常见编程框架，便于对架构图做版本管理。
mingrammer/diagrams.summary_en: A diagram-as-code tool for drawing cloud system architecture in Python, supporting major providers such as AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes, on-premises nodes, and common programming frameworks, making architecture diagrams easy to version.

HeroTransitions/Hero.summary: 为 iOS 与 tvOS 构建视图控制器转场的库，在 UIKit 繁琐的转场 API 之上提供声明式接口，类似 Keynote 的 Magic Move，通过 heroID 自动匹配视图。
HeroTransitions/Hero.summary_en: A library for building iOS and tvOS view-controller transitions that adds a declarative layer over UIKit's cumbersome transition APIs, similar to Keynote's Magic Move, matching views automatically by heroID.

impress/impress.js.summary: 基于 CSS3 变换与过渡的演示文稿框架，灵感来自 prezi.com，可在浏览器中制作带空间移动与缩放效果的演示，并附入门指南。
impress/impress.js.summary_en: A presentation framework based on CSS3 transforms and transitions, inspired by prezi.com, for building browser presentations with spatial movement and zooming, with a getting-started guide.

jaywcjlove/awesome-mac.summary: 按类别系统整理的高质量 macOS 软件精选清单，涵盖开发工具、效率、办公、创意与实用工具等，便于检索和选用。
jaywcjlove/awesome-mac.summary_en: A curated list of high-quality macOS software organized by category, covering developer tools, productivity, office, creative apps, and utilities, for easy search and selection.

Zie619/n8n-workflows.summary: 收集的 n8n 自动化工作流模板合集，可通过基于 SQLite FTS5 的在线搜索界面浏览，也提供 Docker 镜像本地运行。
Zie619/n8n-workflows.summary_en: A collection of n8n automation workflow templates, browsable through an online search interface backed by SQLite FTS5 and runnable locally with Docker.

karan/Projects.summary: 可用任意编程语言完成的实战项目清单，按类别分文件夹，每个项目都可提交解法，适合通过动手练习巩固编程能力。
karan/Projects.summary_en: A list of practical projects that can be solved in any programming language, divided into categories with a folder each and open to contributed solutions, for practicing programming by building.

florinpop17/app-ideas.summary: 为开发者提供应用创意的合集，帮助克服「无从下手」的问题，用于提升编码能力、尝试新技术并丰富作品集。
florinpop17/app-ideas.summary_en: A collection of application ideas for developers who do not know what to build, meant for improving coding skills, experimenting with new technologies, and building a portfolio.

prakhar1989/awesome-courses.summary: 免费公开作业、讲义、笔记和考试的大学计算机课程精选清单，按算法、系统、编程语言与编译器、计算机图形学、安全等方向整理。
prakhar1989/awesome-courses.summary_en: A curated list of university computer science courses that publish their assignments, lectures, notes, and exams online, organized by area such as algorithms, systems, programming languages and compilers, graphics, and security.

ForrestKnight/open-source-cs.summary: 开源计算机科学学位：用 MIT、斯坦福、普林斯顿等名校的免费课程，组成满足本科计算机专业要求（不含通识课）的学习清单。
ForrestKnight/open-source-cs.summary_en: The Open Source Computer Science Degree: a curated list of free courses from universities such as MIT, Stanford, and Princeton that meets the requirements of an undergraduate CS degree, minus general education.

PKUanonym/REKCARC-TSC-UHT.summary: 清华大学计算机系课程攻略，由同学们共同整理各门课程的学习资料与经验，并提供在线网页版本。
PKUanonym/REKCARC-TSC-UHT.summary_en: A guide to courses in the Department of Computer Science and Technology at Tsinghua University, with study materials and experience collected by students, plus an online web version.

forthespada/CS-Books.summary: 超过一千本计算机经典书籍的分享与学习资料，涵盖 C/C++、Java、Python、Go、数据结构与算法、操作系统、数据库、计算机网络、设计模式等方向。
forthespada/CS-Books.summary_en: A shared collection of more than a thousand classic computer science books and study material, covering C/C++, Java, Python, Go, data structures and algorithms, operating systems, databases, networking, and design patterns.

papers-we-love/papers-we-love.summary: 围绕阅读与讨论计算机科学学术论文的社区，仓库是社区推荐的优秀论文目录，因版权原因不一定托管论文，但提供链接。
papers-we-love/papers-we-love.summary_en: A community built around reading and discussing academic computer science papers; the repository is a directory of papers the community recommends, linking to them where the papers cannot be hosted for licensing reasons.

mtdvio/every-programmer-should-know.summary: 每位软件开发者都该了解的（主要是技术性的）资源合集，作者主观推荐，不分先后，涵盖各种技能水平与技术栈。
mtdvio/every-programmer-should-know.summary_en: A collection of mostly technical resources every software developer should know about, highly opinionated and in no particular order, recommended regardless of skill level or tech stack.

geekcomputers/Python.summary: 作者收集的 Python 小程序与脚本合集，用来减少重复劳动并作为初学者的教学示例，欢迎他人指点和改进。
geekcomputers/Python.summary_en: A collection of small Python programs and scripts meant to reduce repetitive work and serve as educational examples for beginners, with the author welcoming pointers and improvements.

walter201230/Python.summary: 面向零基础的中文 Python 教程，基于 Python 3.10+，标注了新版本特性，并提供互动练习版与纯阅读的文档版两个在线站点。
walter201230/Python.summary_en: A Chinese Python tutorial for complete beginners based on Python 3.10+, marking newer-version features, with an interactive practice site and a read-only documentation site.

mouredev/Hello-Python.summary: 面向初学者的西班牙语 Python 课程，含 100 节课、约 44 小时视频、代码与项目，内容从基础到前端、后端、测试等。
mouredev/Hello-Python.summary_en: A Spanish-language Python course for beginners with 100 lessons, about 44 hours of video, code, and projects, running from the fundamentals to front end, back end, and testing.

Pierian-Data/Complete-Python-3-Bootcamp.summary: Udemy 上「Complete Python 3 Bootcamp」课程的配套文件，包含课程使用的代码与笔记本。
Pierian-Data/Complete-Python-3-Bootcamp.summary_en: The companion files for the Complete Python 3 Bootcamp course on Udemy, containing the code and notebooks used in the course.

zhiwehu/Python-programming-exercises.summary: 100 多道 Python 编程练习题，用挑战的形式练习语言与常见编程任务。
zhiwehu/Python-programming-exercises.summary_en: More than 100 Python programming exercises that practice the language and common programming tasks in a challenge format.

gto76/python-cheatsheet.summary: Python 综合速查表，按集合、数据类型、语法规则、内置函数、标准库与第三方库等分章，可下载为文本文件。
gto76/python-cheatsheet.summary_en: A comprehensive Python cheatsheet organized into chapters on collections, data types, syntax rules, built-ins, the standard library, and third-party libraries, downloadable as a text file.

norvig/pytudes.summary: Peter Norvig 的 Python 练习集，借用音乐练习曲的比喻，用短小而有难度的程序打磨特定的编程技巧。
norvig/pytudes.summary_en: Peter Norvig's collection of Python programs, borrowing the musical étude idea, that are short but demanding pieces for perfecting particular programming skills.

EnterpriseQualityCoding/FizzBuzzEnterpri.summary: 以企业级软件的设计原则夸张地实现 FizzBuzz 的讽刺性项目，展示过度设计的架构会是什么样子。
EnterpriseQualityCoding/FizzBuzzEnterpri.summary_en: A satirical project that implements FizzBuzz under the design principles of enterprise software, showing what an over-engineered architecture looks like.

chubin/cheat.sh.summary: 统一查询社区速查表仓库的工具，力求简洁、快速、通用，随时随地即时获得答案。
chubin/cheat.sh.summary_en: A tool giving unified access to the best community-driven cheat sheet repositories, aiming to be concise, fast, universal, and available anywhere.

dylanaraps/pure-bash-bible.summary: 用纯 bash 内置功能替代外部进程的方法合集，可去掉脚本中不必要的依赖并让脚本更快；仓库已归档。
dylanaraps/pure-bash-bible.summary_en: A collection of pure bash alternatives to external processes, using only built-in bash features to remove unneeded dependencies and speed up scripts; the repository is archived.

tiimgreen/github-cheat-sheet.summary: Git 与 GitHub 的实用功能速查表，收录大量鲜为人知的隐藏功能，有多语言翻译。
tiimgreen/github-cheat-sheet.summary_en: A cheat sheet of cool hidden and not-so-hidden features of Git and GitHub, with many translations.

imthenachoman/How-To-Secure-A-Linux-Serv.summary: 持续更新的 Linux 服务器加固指南，从选择发行版、安装到安全配置逐步讲解，也解释各项措施背后的原因。
imthenachoman/How-To-Secure-A-Linux-Serv.summary_en: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server that walks from picking a distribution and installing it through security configuration, also explaining why each measure matters.

mikeroyal/Self-Hosting-Guide.summary: 自托管入门指南，介绍在本地或私有服务器上托管和管理软件应用的工具，涵盖容器、云、WireGuard、自动化、Home Assistant 与网络。
mikeroyal/Self-Hosting-Guide.summary_en: A getting-started guide to self-hosting that covers tools for hosting and managing applications on local or private servers, including containers, cloud, WireGuard, automation, Home Assistant, and networking.

ryanhanwu/How-To-Ask-Questions-The-Smart.summary: Eric S. Raymond 与 Rick Moen《提问的智慧》的中文译本，讲解如何正确提出技术问题、选择合适的论坛并获得满意的回答。
ryanhanwu/How-To-Ask-Questions-The-Smart.summary_en: A Chinese translation of Eric S. Raymond and Rick Moen's "How To Ask Questions The Smart Way", explaining how to ask technical questions well, choose the right forum, and get useful answers.

OWASP/CheatSheetSeries.summary: OWASP 速查表系列：面向开发者、针对具体应用安全主题的简明高价值实践指南，Markdown 源文件同时发布为官方网站。
OWASP/CheatSheetSeries.summary_en: The OWASP Cheat Sheet Series, concise high-value guides on specific application security topics with good security practices for builders, whose Markdown sources are published as the official website.

kdeldycke/awesome-falsehood.summary: 程序员容易相信的错误假设清单，覆盖邮箱、姓名、时间、地址等常见领域，提醒在实现校验逻辑时留意现实中的例外。
kdeldycke/awesome-falsehood.summary_en: A curated list of falsehoods programmers believe in across everyday domains such as email, names, time, and addresses, reminding developers of real-world exceptions when writing validation logic.

viraptor/reverse-interview.summary: 技术岗位求职者在面试中可以反问公司的问题清单，既有想多了解的方面，也有需要警惕的信号。
viraptor/reverse-interview.summary_en: A list of questions a tech job applicant can ask the company during an interview, covering both things worth learning about and red flags.

trimstray/the-book-of-secret-knowledge.summary: 作者日常工作中使用的资料合集，包含清单、手册、速查表、博客、单行命令、命令行与 Web 工具等。
trimstray/the-book-of-secret-knowledge.summary_en: A collection of materials the author uses every day at work, including lists, manuals, cheat sheets, blogs, one-liners, and command-line and web tools.

ibraheemdev/modern-unix.summary: 常用 Unix 命令的现代、更快、更易用替代品清单，如 bat、eza、fd、ripgrep、fzf、delta 等，每项附简介。
ibraheemdev/modern-unix.summary_en: A collection of modern, faster, saner alternatives to common Unix commands such as bat, eza, fd, ripgrep, fzf, and delta, each with a short description.

herrbischoff/awesome-macos-command-line.summary: 在 macOS 终端里完成各种事情的命令与命令行应用精选清单；作者已把项目迁到个人 Git 实例，GitHub 仓库已归档。
herrbischoff/awesome-macos-command-line.summary_en: A curated list of commands and command-line apps for doing things from the macOS terminal; the author moved the project to a personal Git instance and the GitHub repository is archived.

bayandin/awesome-awesomeness.summary: Awesome 清单的清单，按编程语言、包管理器、前端、后端、数据库、运维等主题汇总各领域的 Awesome 列表。
bayandin/awesome-awesomeness.summary_en: A list of awesome lists that gathers Awesome lists by topic such as programming languages, package managers, front end, back end, databases, and operations.

kuchin/awesome-cto.summary: 面向创业公司 CTO 与研发副总裁的资源精选清单，涵盖招聘、团队管理、职业成长、项目管理、开发流程、架构与技术选型等。
kuchin/awesome-cto.summary_en: A curated list of resources for CTOs and VPs of R&D with an emphasis on startups, covering hiring, people management, career growth, project management, development process, architecture, and technologies.

MunGell/awesome-for-beginners.summary: 适合初学者提交第一个拉取请求的开源项目清单，标有 first-timers-only 一类标签，帮助新人找到可参与的入门任务。
MunGell/awesome-for-beginners.summary_en: A list of beginner-friendly open-source projects where newcomers can make a first pull request, tagged with labels such as first-timers-only so they can find approachable tasks.

sdmg15/Best-websites-a-programmer-should.summary: 程序员值得访问的网站合集，按遇到问题时、新闻、杂志、编程练习、加密货币等主题分类；仓库已归档。
sdmg15/Best-websites-a-programmer-should.summary_en: A list of useful websites for programmers grouped by when you get stuck, news, magazines, coding practice, cryptocurrency, and other topics; the repository is archived.

kilimchoi/engineering-blogs.summary: 软件工程博客精选清单，按公司、个人或团体、产品与技术分类，按字母顺序检索。
kilimchoi/engineering-blogs.summary_en: A curated list of software engineering blogs grouped into companies, individuals and groups, and products and technologies, indexed alphabetically.

emmabostian/developer-portfolios.summary: 开发者个人作品集网站的合集，收录两千多个作品集，按字母顺序排列，可为自己的作品集提供灵感。
emmabostian/developer-portfolios.summary_en: A collection of developer portfolio websites, listing more than two thousand alphabetically, to inspire your own portfolio.

GitHubDaily/GitHubDaily.summary: 自 2015 年起持续分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站与成熟应用的中文项目，已累计分享一万多个开源项目。
GitHubDaily/GitHubDaily.summary_en: A Chinese-language project that has shared high-quality, interesting, useful open-source tutorials, developer tools, programming sites, and mature apps on GitHub since 2015, with more than ten thousand projects shared so far.

521xueweihan/HelloGitHub.summary: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的中文月刊，每月 28 日发布，内容包含开源项目、开源书籍、实战项目与企业级项目。
521xueweihan/HelloGitHub.summary_en: A Chinese-language monthly that shares interesting, entry-level open-source projects on GitHub, published on the 28th of each month with open-source projects, books, hands-on projects, and enterprise-level projects.

ruanyf/weekly.summary: 阮一峰的科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布，记录每周值得分享的科技内容，也接受文章、软件与资源投稿。
ruanyf/weekly.summary_en: Ruan Yifeng's weekly for tech enthusiasts, published every Friday, recording tech content worth sharing each week and accepting submissions of articles, software, and resources.

timqian/chinese-independent-blogs.summary: 中文独立博客列表，按 RSS 订阅数据排序，收录博客的简介、地址与标签，也说明什么是独立博客以及如何提交。
timqian/chinese-independent-blogs.summary_en: A list of Chinese independent blogs sorted by RSS subscription data, with each blog's introduction, address, and tags, and notes on what an independent blog is and how to submit one.

n0shake/Public-APIs.summary: 按类别整理的公开 API 清单，涵盖广告、分析、日历、加密货币、天气等数十个领域，并标注开源与试用类 API。
n0shake/Public-APIs.summary_en: A categorized list of public APIs across dozens of domains such as advertising, analytics, calendars, cryptocurrency, and weather, marking open-source and trial-based APIs.

dipakkr/A-to-Z-Resources-for-Students.summary: 面向学生与从业者的开发者资源精选清单，涵盖学习编程语言、参加社区活动、全球会议、黑客松与竞赛等。
dipakkr/A-to-Z-Resources-for-Students.summary_en: A curated list of resources for students and professionals, covering learning programming languages, community events, global conferences, hackathons, and competitions.

abhisheknaiidu/awesome-github-profile-re.summary: 精美 GitHub 个人主页 README 的精选清单，按 GitHub Actions、动态实时、极简、徽章、图标等风格分类，并附工具与教程。
abhisheknaiidu/awesome-github-profile-re.summary_en: A curated list of great GitHub profile READMEs grouped by style such as GitHub Actions, dynamic real time, minimalistic, badges, and icons, with tools and tutorials.

kahun/awesome-sysadmin.summary: 面向系统管理员的开源软件精选清单，涵盖备份、构建自动化、ChatOps、配置管理、CI/CD、部署自动化、DNS 等主题。
kahun/awesome-sysadmin.summary_en: A curated list of open-source resources for system administrators, covering backups, build automation, ChatOps, configuration management, CI/CD, deployment automation, DNS, and more.

dkhamsing/open-source-ios-apps.summary: 开源 iOS、iPadOS、watchOS、tvOS 与 visionOS 应用的协作清单，按开发者工具、终端、教育、金融、游戏等类别整理，可作为学习范例。
dkhamsing/open-source-ios-apps.summary_en: A collaborative list of open-source iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps grouped by categories such as developer tools, terminal, education, finance, and games, useful as learning examples.

goabstract/Awesome-Design-Tools.summary: 设计工具与插件的精选清单，涵盖设计插件、设计会议与设计 UI 套件等，由 Abstract 旗下 Flawless App 团队维护。
goabstract/Awesome-Design-Tools.summary_en: A curated list of design tools and plugins, including design plugins, conferences, and UI kits, maintained by the Flawless App team at Abstract.

anuraghazra/github-readme-stats.summary: 为 GitHub README 动态生成统计卡片的服务；README 说明该仓库不再维护，建议改用后继项目 GitHub Stats Extended。
anuraghazra/github-readme-stats.summary_en: A service that dynamically generates stats cards for GitHub READMEs; the README says the repository is no longer maintained and points to the successor project GitHub Stats Extended.

rahuldkjain/github-profile-readme-genera.summary: 用简洁界面生成 GitHub 个人主页 README 的工具，填写姓名、简介、平台账号后可加入访客计数、GitHub 统计等附加内容。
rahuldkjain/github-profile-readme-genera.summary_en: A tool that generates a GitHub profile README through a minimal UI, letting you fill in name, tagline, and platform usernames and add extras such as visitor counts and GitHub stats.

mitmproxy/mitmproxy.summary: 支持 SSL/TLS 的交互式拦截代理，面向渗透测试人员与软件开发者，提供 HTTP/1、HTTP/2 与 WebSocket 的控制台界面，另有命令行版 mitmdump 和网页版 mitmweb。
mitmproxy/mitmproxy.summary_en: An interactive SSL/TLS-capable intercepting proxy for penetration testers and software developers, with a console interface for HTTP/1, HTTP/2, and WebSockets, plus a command-line version, mitmdump, and a web interface, mitmweb.

ehang-io/nps.summary: 轻量高性能的内网穿透代理服务器，支持 TCP、UDP、SOCKS5、HTTP 等协议转发，可用于访问内网网站、调试本地接口、SSH 与远程桌面，带 Web 管理端。
ehang-io/nps.summary_en: A lightweight, high-performance intranet penetration proxy server forwarding TCP, UDP, SOCKS5, HTTP, and other traffic, for reaching internal sites, debugging local endpoints, SSH, and remote desktop, with a web management console.

fosrl/pangolin.summary: 基于 WireGuard 的开源 SASE 平台，把零信任 VPN、零信任反向代理、特权访问管理和身份感知的 AI 网关放在同一套身份与策略模型下。
fosrl/pangolin.summary_en: An open-source SASE platform built on WireGuard that combines a zero-trust VPN, a zero-trust reverse proxy, privileged access management, and an identity-aware AI gateway under one identity and policy model.

chaitin/SafeLine.summary: 自托管的 Web 应用防火墙与反向代理，通过过滤和监控 HTTP 流量保护 Web 应用免受 SQL 注入、XSS、代码注入等攻击。
chaitin/SafeLine.summary_en: A self-hosted web application firewall and reverse proxy that filters and monitors HTTP traffic to protect web apps from attacks such as SQL injection, XSS, and code injection.

TecharoHQ/anubis.summary: Web AI 防火墙工具，通过挑战机制衡量请求来源，保护上游资源免受爬虫机器人冲击，尽量保持轻量以便小型站点使用。
TecharoHQ/anubis.summary_en: A web AI firewall utility that weighs incoming connections with challenges to protect upstream resources from scraper bots, kept lightweight so small sites can afford it.

binwiederhier/ntfy.summary: 基于 HTTP 的简单发布订阅通知服务，可通过 PUT / POST 从脚本向手机或桌面推送通知，无需注册，也可自行部署。
binwiederhier/ntfy.summary_en: A simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service that sends notifications to a phone or desktop from scripts via PUT or POST without signing up, and can also be self-hosted.

huginn/huginn.summary: 用于构建自动执行任务的代理系统，代理读取网页、监听事件并采取行动，事件沿有向图传播，可看作自托管、可深度定制的 IFTTT 或 Zapier。
huginn/huginn.summary_en: A system for building agents that perform automated tasks online, reading the web, watching for events, and acting on them, with events flowing along a directed graph; a hackable, self-hosted take on IFTTT or Zapier.

fingerprintjs/fingerprintjs.summary: 开源的客户端浏览器指纹库，通过读取浏览器属性计算出哈希访问者标识，在无痕模式和清除浏览器数据后依然保持不变。
fingerprintjs/fingerprintjs.summary_en: An open-source client-side browser fingerprinting library that computes a hashed visitor identifier from browser attributes, staying the same in incognito mode and after browser data is cleared.

webtorrent/webtorrent.summary: 用纯 JavaScript 编写的流式 BitTorrent 客户端，同一份代码可运行在 Node.js 与浏览器中，浏览器里通过 WebRTC 数据通道实现点对点传输。
webtorrent/webtorrent.summary_en: A streaming torrent client written entirely in JavaScript that runs the same code in Node.js and the browser, using WebRTC data channels for peer-to-peer transport in the browser.

bilibili/flv.js.summary: 用纯 JavaScript 编写、不依赖 Flash 的 HTML5 FLV 播放器，借助 Media Source Extensions 把 FLV 转封装为 MP4 分片；README 说明项目将很少维护。
bilibili/flv.js.summary_en: An HTML5 FLV player written in pure JavaScript without Flash, transmuxing FLV into fragmented MP4 through Media Source Extensions; the README says the project will be rarely maintained.

ocornut/imgui.summary: Dear ImGui：面向 C++ 的轻量图形用户界面库，依赖极少，采用即时模式设计。
ocornut/imgui.summary_en: Dear ImGui, a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ with minimal dependencies and an immediate-mode design.

jhao104/proxy_pool.summary: 面向网络爬虫的 Python 代理 IP 池，自动从免费代理源抓取并校验代理，提供 API 获取可用代理，并支持扩展新的代理来源。
jhao104/proxy_pool.summary_en: A Python proxy IP pool for web crawlers that fetches and validates proxies from free sources, exposes an API for usable proxies, and supports adding new proxy sources.

marimo-team/marimo.summary: 响应式 Python 笔记本：运行单元格或操作界面元素后自动运行相关单元格，笔记本以纯 Python 存储，可作为脚本执行或部署为应用，并支持 SQL 与 Git 版本管理。
marimo-team/marimo.summary_en: A reactive Python notebook that automatically reruns dependent cells when you run a cell or interact with a UI element, stored as pure Python, executable as a script, deployable as an app, with SQL support and Git-friendly versioning.

microsoft/WSL.summary: 适用于 Linux 的 Windows 子系统，可在 Windows 上直接运行未经修改的 Linux 命令行工具和应用，无需传统虚拟机或双系统。
microsoft/WSL.summary_en: The Windows Subsystem for Linux, which runs unmodified Linux command-line tools and applications directly on Windows without a traditional virtual machine or dual boot.

jgm/pandoc.summary: 通用标记语言转换器：既是 Haskell 库也是命令行工具，可在 Markdown、AsciiDoc、HTML、LaTeX、DOCX 等多种格式之间转换。
jgm/pandoc.summary_en: The universal markup converter, both a Haskell library and a command-line tool, converting between many formats such as Markdown, AsciiDoc, HTML, LaTeX, and DOCX.

tonsky/FiraCode.summary: 带编程连字的免费等宽字体，把常见的多字符符号序列（如箭头、比较运算符）渲染为更易读的单个字形，并附安装与排错说明。
tonsky/FiraCode.summary_en: A free monospaced font with programming ligatures that renders common multi-character symbol sequences such as arrows and comparison operators as single readable glyphs, with installation and troubleshooting notes.

ryanoasis/nerd-fonts.summary: 为开发者字体打补丁的项目，把 3600 多个图标和字形集合（Font Awesome、Material Design Icons、Octicons 等）合并进 50 多款常用编程字体，并提供字体补丁工具。
ryanoasis/nerd-fonts.summary_en: A project that patches developer fonts with a high number of glyphs, merging more than 3,600 icons from sets such as Font Awesome, Material Design Icons, and Octicons into over 50 popular coding fonts, with a font patcher.

be5invis/Iosevka.summary: 为编写代码、终端使用和技术文档设计的开源无衬线加板状衬线等宽字体族。
be5invis/Iosevka.summary_en: An open-source sans-serif and slab-serif monospace typeface family designed for writing code, using in terminals, and preparing technical documents.

microsoft/cascadia-code.summary: 随 Windows Terminal 一同发布的编程字体，包含连字，现已是 Visual Studio 的默认字体，并提供带 Powerline 与 Nerd Font 符号的变体。
microsoft/cascadia-code.summary_en: A coding font with programming ligatures that ships with Windows Terminal and is now the default font in Visual Studio, with variants that embed Powerline and Nerd Font symbols.

subframe7536/maple-font.summary: Maple Mono：带连字与 Nerd Font 图标、圆角设计的开源等宽字体，适合 IDE 与终端，中英文宽度为 2:1，提供细粒度的自定义选项。
subframe7536/maple-font.summary_en: Maple Mono, an open-source monospace font with round corners, ligatures, and Nerd Font icons for IDEs and terminals, with a 2:1 Chinese-to-Latin width ratio and fine-grained customization options.

powerline/fonts.summary: 为 Powerline 状态栏插件预先打过补丁并调整过的字体集合，提供安装脚本，Debian 与 Ubuntu 系统也有对应软件包。
powerline/fonts.summary_en: A collection of pre-patched and adjusted fonts for the Powerline statusline plugin, with an install script and packages for Debian and Ubuntu-based systems.

dracula/dracula-theme.summary: Dracula 主题：一个配色方案覆盖 VS Code、iTerm、Vim、JetBrains、Windows Terminal、Zsh 等 400 多个应用，附完整调色板。
dracula/dracula-theme.summary_en: The Dracula theme, one color scheme available for more than 400 applications including VS Code, iTerm, Vim, JetBrains, Windows Terminal, and Zsh, with a full color palette.

mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes.summary: 600 多套终端配色方案，最初面向 iTerm2，并移植到 Terminal、Konsole、PuTTY、Windows Terminal、Alacritty、Ghostty 等众多终端与应用。
mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes.summary_en: More than 600 terminal color schemes originally for iTerm2, with ports to Terminal, Konsole, PuTTY, Windows Terminal, Alacritty, Ghostty, and dozens of other terminals and apps.
